title: BIM Modeller PHE
description:
We are looking for an experienced BIM Modeler – PHE with 8–10 years of relevant experience in commercial projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing detailed PHE/Plumbing BIM models, preparing drawings and documentation, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring the quality and timely delivery of project deliverables.

  • Develop and maintain detailed PHE/Plumbing BIM models using Revit MEP.
  • Model domestic water supply, drainage, stormwater, sanitary, and other plumbing systems.
  • Prepare plumbing layouts, riser diagrams, schematics, sections, and detailed drawings.
  • Coordinate PHE models with Architectural, Structural, HVAC, Electrical, and Fire Fighting disciplines.
  • Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues using Navisworks or similar BIM coordination tools.
  • Prepare detailed shop drawings, schedules, and documentation as required.
  • Ensure BIM models and drawings comply with project standards, specifications, and BIM Execution Plans.
  • Participate in BIM coordination meetings and collaborate with architects, engineers, BIM coordinators, and other stakeholders.
  • Review models and drawings for accuracy, completeness, and quality.
  • Support the BIM team in resolving technical and modeling-related issues.
  • Maintain model integrity and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical Engineering, Plumbing Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8–10 years of relevant experience in PHE/Plumbing BIM modeling.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Revit MEP and AutoCAD.
  • Good working knowledge of Navisworks and BIM coordination processes.
  • Strong understanding of water supply, drainage, sanitary, stormwater, and plumbing systems.
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial projects such as hotels, hospitals, offices, retail, mixed-use developments, and high-rise buildings.
  • Knowledge of BIM standards, modeling practices, and multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

title: Senior Store Design Manager
description:

The Senior Store Design Manager leads the design and delivery of new and remodeled DICK’S Sporting Goods stores, blending brand, merchandising, and athlete experience into high-performing retail environments. This role drives design strategy, team leadership, and cross-functional execution—ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned to business goals.

Design Innovation and Leadership

  • Ideate creative concepts, illustrate ideas, and be a leader who delivers impactful/scalable design solutions

  • Utilizing 3D modeling and 2D drawings, present compelling design concepts and prototypes to senior leadership, articulating the vision and rationale behind each creative decision.

  • Act as the design ambassador for the company, representing DICK'S Sporting Goods at industry events and fostering relationships with key partners.

Strategic Planning and Execution

  • Translate business objectives and customer insights into actionable design strategies that drive foot traffic, engagement, and sales.

  • Oversee the entire design process from concept to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Identify and resolve design challenges proactively, leveraging creative problem-solving skills to overcome site-specific constraints.

  • Lead the roll-out of key design initiatives across new and existing stores, ensuring seamless implementation and consistency of vision. Fostering strong partnerships with internal stakeholders (e.g., Merchandising, Operations, Marketing) to align store design with broader business strategies.

  • Collaborate with external vendors and design firms to bring fresh perspectives and cutting-edge solutions to DICK'S Sporting Goods' retail environments.

  • Facilitate the incorporation of business strategies and insights into merchandising plans and store designs

Team Leadership and Development

  • Inspire and mentor a team of Store Designers, fostering a culture of creativity, innovation, and design excellence.

  • Enhance engagement and empowering direct reports by fostering growth and professional development through continuous dialogue and the formulation of individualized development plans (IDPs).

  • Provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and growth opportunities to team members, nurturing their professional development and design skills.

  • Attract and retain top design talent, building a high-performing team capable of delivering world-class retail environments.

  • Promote a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages diverse perspectives and innovative thinking. Partners with Architectural Design Team to ensure the Prototype Managing Architect (PMA) adheres to all company requirements.

  • Ensures the team maintains the interior drawings accurate and orderly archives.

  • Manage a library of design tools such as tracking interior details, material finish boards, and shop drawings.

  • Manages and tracks the value engineering process to develop and facilitate prototypical specific cost working with internal and external partners on all banners.

  • Continually finds and presents cost savings ideas as not to negatively impact the customer experience.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Architecture or Interior Design

  • 7-10 years of experience in Architecture, Interior Design, Retail design industry/environments experience, preferred

  • Architect or Interior Design License preferred but not required

  • Proficient in Revit BIM software, Adobe Creative Suite, AutoCad, and Sketchup

  • Experience in V-Ray and Enscape is a plus

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and lead multiple projects, in a fast paced and dynamic environment

  • Excellent relationship building skills among a wide range of stakeholders

  • Ability to confidently present to Executive Leadership

  • Strong cross-functional knowledge in a variety of retail functions, including Merchandising, Store Ops, Planning, Visual Merchandising and Store Design

  • Expert in applying design skills including concepting, ideation, special design in scale, and space planning layouts

The Grocery Clerk is responsible for keeping all store grocery shelves stocked and clean during business hours. They are required to assist customers as needed and maintain a friendly, energetic demeanor. This position requires adhering to all procedural guidelines set by the Grocery Department.

title: Senior Bridge Engineer
description:
The Senior Bridge Engineer will support infrastructure detailed design for our bridge team. The bridge team works collaboratively with our divisional team across Ontario.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leading in producing engineering products for bridge rehabilitation and new design projects from concept through construction to meet customer quality requirements.
  • Complete detailed structural design calculations and analysis.
  • Work independently and as part of a team to define problems, establish work scope, prepare budgets and schedules, plan the work, and provide technical direction and oversight.
  • Prepare and check detailed engineering models, drawings, specifications, quantities, cost estimates, and technical reports.
  • Develop and review designs for new bridges and bridge rehabilitation.
  • Provide expertise and services related to the evaluation, inspection, and rehabilitation of transportation structures.
  • Review cost estimates, specifications, and tender documents prepared by junior engineers.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with other engineering disciplines and departments, including highway, foundation, environmental, drainage, and electrical.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with clients.
  • Perform project management duties, including assembling and managing project teams, controlling budgets and schedules, ensuring quality control, and managing client interactions.
  • Provide input and technical guidance to CAD Designer/Drafters, Designers, and less experienced Engineers.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable codes and regulations.
  • Bachelor or Master degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
  • Licensed as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.).
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive design experience for MTO and municipalities projects involves steel and concrete bridge structures in Ontario.
  • Must be able to lead detailed design and contract preparation together with team member and as self-directed manner.
  • Proficient user of structural analysis software (Midas and CSiBridge).
  • Sound and in-depth knowledge in MTO standards and policies, Highway Bridge Design Code (CSA-S6), AASHTO and ARIMA Codes.
  • Ability to provide construction liaison and act as Contract Administrator.
  • Ability to review and sign-off of technical design reports.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Sound understanding of other disciplines scope and ability to liaise.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Coordinator with 7–8 years of relevant experience in commercial projects. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project activities, ensuring effective communication between project stakeholders, monitoring project progress, and supporting the project team in delivering projects within the agreed timelines, budget, and quality standards.

  • Coordinate and monitor day-to-day project activities to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Act as a key point of coordination between clients, consultants, architects, engineers, contractors, and internal project teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project schedules, trackers, progress reports, and project documentation.
  • Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and highlight delays, risks, and critical issues.
  • Organize and coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, and circulate minutes of meetings (MoM).
  • Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure of pending tasks.
  • Coordinate the submission and review of drawings, documents, and technical deliverables.
  • Support the project team in managing project deliverables and key milestones.
  • Maintain project records, correspondence, approvals, and documentation.
  • Assist in identifying project risks and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.
  • Monitor project changes and ensure effective communication of updates to concerned teams.
  • Prepare regular project status reports and updates for management.
  • Ensure effective coordination between multidisciplinary teams and support overall project delivery.
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 7–8 years of relevant experience in project coordination and management.
  • Experience working on commercial projects such as hotels, hospitals, offices, retail, mixed-use developments, and high-rise buildings.
  • Strong knowledge of project coordination, documentation, scheduling, and reporting.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, MS Excel, MS Project, or other project management tools.
  • Good understanding of construction processes and multidisciplinary project coordination.
  • Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

title: Assistant Director - Category Management, Software and Infrastructure
description:
AD Category Mgmt - FP07BE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Assistant Director, Software and Infrastructure Category Management is responsible for developing and executing category strategies for complex, high‑value spend categories. Reporting to the AVP, Category Lead for Software & Infrastructure, this role manages categories typically ranging from $40M-$75M in annual spend and plays a critical role in translating enterprise procurement strategy into actionable category plans and measurable business outcomes.

Location

This role can have a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Candidates who live near Hartford will have an expectation of working in an office in alignment to our hybrid work schedule (currently three days per week (Tuesday through Thursday)). Candidates who live near other office locations may have a similar expectation or may have a remote work arrangement depending on location. Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work arrangement, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develops and executes category strategies aligned to enterprise objectives
  • Conducts market analysis to understand trends, cost drivers, risks and opportunities
  • Establishes category level objectives
  • Functions as a trusted advisor for senior leaders through the category management and sourcing journey, providing clear recommendations and insights supported by data.
  • Drives significant reductions in cost while optimizing value through demand- and supply-side opportunities.
  • Identifies and mitigates supplier, commercial, operational, and compliance risks within assigned categories.
  • Develops and implements category best practices.
  • Leads end-to-end sourcing initiatives
  • Develops negotiation strategies and leads supplier negotiations for commercial, risk and service outcomes.
  • Drafts and negotiates contracts of varying complexity in partnership with Legal when needed, ensuring compliance with business, regulatory and risk requirements.
  • Brings software market expertise to deliver both cost savings and business value.
  • Ensures consistent contract quality, documentation standards and adherence to procurement policies.
  • Uses spend analytics, performance dashboards, and sourcing insights to inform decisions and prioritize opportunities.
  • Utilizes procurement technology to support the end-to-end procurement lifecycle and drive efficiency, transparency and value.
  • Manages strategic supplier relationships and contract portfolios.
  • Ensures accuracy and integrity of sourcing, supplier, and contract data within enterprise systems.
  • Partners with business and functional stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with operational and strategic needs.
  • Identifies opportunities to apply emerging tools and AI-enabled capabilities to category management activities.
  • Maintains a high standard of customer engagement and service.
  • Models enterprise leadership principles by driving results with accountability and integrity, partnering effectively across functions with an enterprise mindset, using data and insights to inform decisions, continuously improving how work gets done, contributing to a high-performing, inclusive team culture, embracing change and helping others adapt to evolving priorities and tools.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of category management, strategic sourcing, and contract negotiation experience within the software category.
  • Proven experience developing and executing category strategies.
  • Experience leading market analysis and intelligence gathering.
  • Extensive negotiation and contracting expertise.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in procurement, supply chain, finance or business. Advanced degree or equivalent experience a plus.

Skills and Capabilities

  • Strong strategic and execution mindset with knowledge of category management and sourcing best practices
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret spend data, market insights and performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating and structuring commercial agreements.
  • Excellent stakeholder influence and relationship management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project management skills, including leading cross-functional sourcing initiatives.
  • Knowledge of change management and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong customer-service orientation.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity through influence and collaboration.
  • Knowledge of source-to-pay processes
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; Coupa experience a plus.
  • Innovative, curious mindset with an interest in modern procurement technologies and data-driven approaches.

Compensation

$113,600 - $170,400

title: Global Study Associate Director - CVRM
description:
Join us as a Global Study Associate Director (GSAD) in our BioPharmaceuticals Clinical Operations team at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D site in Gothenburg (Sweden). This role is pivotal in the delivery of clinical studies, providing direction and guidance to a cross-functional study team within the Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM) therapy area. Accountabilities

You will be responsible for developing essential study level documents, overseeing external service providers, and ensuring all systems used at a study-level are current and accurate. Additionally, you will be responsible for study budget re-forecasting and management throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated solid project management skills

  • Strong abilities in team leadership with experience from cross-functional leadership of a clinical study or part of a clinical study

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities

title: Data Engineer
description:
Nexters is an international game development company that strives to introduce the joy of core gaming experiences to casual players. In 2021 we went public and listed on the NASDAQ (GDEV). Nexters is part of the GDEV holding, which also includes Cubic Games, Royal Ark, Game Gear studios. Our people work worldwide from offices in Cyprus, Armenia, and Kazakhstan or remotely. We want brilliant professionals who love building great games in a team with one of the best cultures.

About your role

We are seeking a Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, as well as supporting and refactoring existing solutions. The primary ownership area will be the Bronze and Silver layers of our data platform.

What you'll do:

  • Design and develop batch and streaming data pipelines

  • Build and maintain data ingestion from internal and external sources

  • Develop and evolve data lake / data warehouse models

  • Optimize performance of Spark-based data processing jobs

  • Develop and maintain dbt models and data contracts

  • Implement and support monitoring, observability, and data quality checks

  • Work with Kafka-based streaming pipelines

  • Collaborate with analytics, marketing, platform, and backend teams

What we're looking for:

  • Strong SQL and Python skills

  • Solid production experience building ETL / ELT pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with Spark / PySpark, especially in streaming scenarios

  • Understanding of distributed data processing and storage systems

  • Experience working with data lake / data warehouse architectures

  • Practical experience with Delta tables, Parquet, and S3

  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or similar

  • Experience working with Kafka and streaming pipelines

  • Experience maintaining and improving production-grade data pipelines

  • Experience with observability, monitoring, and data quality practices

What we offer

  • Healthcare
    Medical care program (including dental service) or medical care compensation are available for you wherever you wish to work. The medical care program (basic package) is also available for your family members if you choose to work from our official locations – Cyprus, Armenia, and Kazakhstan.

  • Work, life, and balance
    We offer a fair amount of paid vacation days and sick leave. You can work at one of our comfortable offices in official locations or from home.

  • Sports
    You can choose various sports activities like yoga, football, and volleyball in our official locations.

  • Relocation support
    A relocation package is available for you if you decide to join us in one of our official locations.

  • Skills improvement
    Let's learn languages: you can visit online English language courses. Greek and Armenian language lessons are available for everyone who works in Cyprus or Armenia. Our company encourages people of Nexters to take part in game jams, hackathons, and relevant conferences and meetups as expert speakers.

  • Community & ESG
    We are proud of our local communities and support employees’ social initiatives. Dream big, act big: Nexters contribute to gaming’s positive impact on the world, hold a sustainability strategy, and take part in charity projects all over the world

title: Senior Bridge Engineer
description:
The Senior Bridge Engineer will support infrastructure detailed design for our bridge team. The bridge team works collaboratively with our divisional team across Ontario.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leading in producing engineering products for bridge rehabilitation and new design projects from concept through construction to meet customer quality requirements.
  • Complete detailed structural design calculations and analysis.
  • Work independently and as part of a team to define problems, establish work scope, prepare budgets and schedules, plan the work, and provide technical direction and oversight.
  • Prepare and check detailed engineering models, drawings, specifications, quantities, cost estimates, and technical reports.
  • Develop and review designs for new bridges and bridge rehabilitation.
  • Provide expertise and services related to the evaluation, inspection, and rehabilitation of transportation structures.
  • Review cost estimates, specifications, and tender documents prepared by junior engineers.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with other engineering disciplines and departments, including highway, foundation, environmental, drainage, and electrical.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with clients.
  • Perform project management duties, including assembling and managing project teams, controlling budgets and schedules, ensuring quality control, and managing client interactions.
  • Provide input and technical guidance to CAD Designer/Drafters, Designers, and less experienced Engineers.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable codes and regulations.
  • Bachelor or Master degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
  • Licensed as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.).
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive design experience for MTO and municipalities projects involves steel and concrete bridge structures in Ontario.
  • Must be able to lead detailed design and contract preparation together with team member and as self-directed manner.
  • Proficient user of structural analysis software (Midas and CSiBridge).
  • Sound and in-depth knowledge in MTO standards and policies, Highway Bridge Design Code (CSA-S6), AASHTO and ARIMA Codes.
  • Ability to provide construction liaison and act as Contract Administrator.
  • Ability to review and sign-off of technical design reports.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Sound understanding of other disciplines scope and ability to liaise.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license.

title: PM Sanitation Lead
description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Sanitation Manager, this position will lead all phases of sanitation on shift. The lead will be responsible for achieving results for safety, sanitation, team performance and budgeting labor. In addition, this candidate will be heavily involved in training, food safety program implementation, sanitation documentation and enforcing standard operating procedures and facility policies. Ensures that all food safety and quality requirements are met, including site standards, company policies and regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Direct line sanitation during equipment downtime on all production lines to include cookies and crackers

Perform equipment and cleaning verification activities through visual inspections, allergen swabbing, indicator swabbing, and ATP

Execute facility Master Sanitation Schedule by scheduling and assigning labor based on cleaning priority and line availability, as well as supporting the Sanitation Preventative Control schedule

Act as Quality and Food Safety program subject matter expert on assigned Shift, working with the QA specialist to provide support to production lines as needed

Assist with basic maintenance and adjustment of equipment

Responsible for ensuring team is up to date on training and that all safety procedures are being followed

Support, comply and enforce facility Good Manufacturing Practices

Develop work schedules and collaborate with other leads in maximizing labor and completing required weekday and weekend work lists

Complete special projects, as assigned, to include 5s, Safety, Continuous Improvement, performing Root Cause Analysis and assisting with the implementation of Sanitation Standard Works

Other duties as assigned by Sanitation Manager or QA Manager

This individual will be required to demonstrate leadership consistent with the Campbell Leadership Model and exhibit these behaviors by promoting participative, open communication with team members and maintaining positive employment relations on the shift through fair consistent interpretation and enforcement of company policies.


ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Ability to set-up, operate and clean equipment in a safe and productive manner.

Obtain a forklift license and wave license within 90 days.

Fall Protection and Confined Space training within 180 days.

Enter work notifications in SAP and complete follow ups on repairs.

Correctly coding timecards in the UKG system.

Creating daily and weekly schedules and job assignments for the Sanitation team.

Completing individual development goals with team members and measure performance.

Implement and create work instructions, job breakdown Sheets, cleaning forms and sanitation operating procedures.

Respond to pest control, roof leak, drain backup, bloodborne pathogens, flour system failure and food safety incidences.

Position will regularly be required to direct and participate in weekend sanitation assignments. Will occasionally be required to attend training, meetings and perform work that may be scheduled during off shift hours.

Physical Demands:

Frequently required to stand and walk for prolonged periods of time. Occasionally required to reach, climb and maintain balance at height while using fall protection equipment. Capable of lifting and moving up to 50 pounds repeatedly throughout a single shift.

EDUCATION and/ or EXPERIENCE:

High School Diploma or Equivalent required and ability to read, write and communicate in English

College degree, B.A./B.S., is preferred but not required based on qualifications and experience.

1 to 3 years’ previous supervisory experience preferred.

Previous experience in food processing sanitation or facilities management

Strong interpersonal and leadership skills and excellent verbal and written communication skills are required.

To perform this job successfully, an individual will be required to be competent in all Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and can quickly learn other software systems to include SAP, SharePoint and UKG Timekeeping.

Pay: $29.90/hour

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

title: Academic Services and Student Life Specialist
description:
NABA London is the first international campus of Nuova Accademia di Belle Arti, opening in East London in October 2026. Combining Italian design heritage with London’s creative industries, NABA London will offer an international, studio-based learning environment for students across art, design, fashion, and creative disciplines. Located at Here East in the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, the new campus represents an exciting opportunity to join a growing institution at launch stage and contribute to shaping the student experience from day one. Programmes delivered at NABA London are validated by Regent's University London.

NABA London is currently seeking for motivated individuals for the role of

Academic Services and Student Life Specialist

The successful candidate will be based in London and will report directly to the Communication and Student Services Manager.The Academic Services and Student Life Specialist is responsible for coordinating the delivery of teaching and academic activities and contributing to the efficient use of campus spaces. The role provides comprehensive operational support to the Head of Education and Teaching Faculty, ensuring the timely preparation of course and workshop schedules and that all activities are effectively organised for students and tutors. The postholder oversees activities and services related to Student Life and Student Wellbeing and ensures the distribution of student satisfaction surveys. Working closely with the Academic Registration & Student Support Specialist, the role shares day-to-day responsibilities to ensure continuity of operations and services. The position also supports reception activities and the management of incoming calls.

The selected candidate will carry out the following activities:

Student Support:

  • Supervise the correct management of academic activities for students during their studies
  • Provide information about timetable and on any Academy’s activity or administrative deadline involving them; manage the e-mail notice communication with students
  • Assure the student welcome and induction days organization
  • Prepare / update annually welcome vademecum (on term basis) and the service guide

Faculty Support:

  • Facilitate tutors and Course Leaders, by managing various organizational aspects which can daily arise in the lessons’ / academic activities’ and ensure compliance with company guidelines
  • Might be nominated as member of the Course Panels with active role in it

Space Management, Course Planning, event’s organization:

  • Support the definition of Academic Calendars
  • Supervise the elaboration of courses and workshops timetables, collecting the needs of Course Leaders for all didactic activities in accordance with Academic Calendar and Plan of Study
  • Manage all the information on the available Student information System and Timetable System Support the collection of tutors, translators and guest lecturers information to HR for contractual needs.
  • Manage the rescheduling of the planned activites.
  • Guarantee the booking of spaces for all the non-academic activities requested by all the offices
  • Monitor and forecast spaces’ occupancy when requested

Student Life & Wellbeing:

  • Oversee the promotion of student social integration within the campus and the UK culture by engaging them in extracurricular activities and providing them with general information
  • Facilitate special deals agreements with external providers for students, tutors and staff
  • Signpost and help students when in need of Wellbeing Services and liaise with Course Leaders in case of SEN students
  • Act as the primary point of contact for the Student Representatives
  • Also supports the organization of the Graduation event

Students Surveys:

  • Ensure activities of distributing surveys and collect student feedback
  • Support the Data analysis

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.
  • Previous experience in an administrative, student services, customer service, or higher education environment is desirable; early-career candidates with strong potential will also be considered.
  • Familiarity with academic management systems (e.g., student management software) and administrative practices in educational contexts (particularly in the UK or higher education sector).
  • Experience in managing timetables, planning, and coordinating academic events and activities.

Interpersonal and Soft Skills

  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to follow policies, procedures, and administrative processes accurately and consistently.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and creative, with a genuine interest in fostering student engagement and contributing to a vibrant student life experience.
  • Customer-focused and confident communicator with excellent interpersonal skills, able to build professional and supportive relationships with students, staff, and visitors while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Flexible and adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced academic start-up environment while maintaining high standards of service and occasionally adjusting working hours to support events and student activities.

Technical and Organizational Skills

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively manage timetables and academic resources, ensuring all activities are scheduled on time and without conflicts.
  • Excellent understanding of academic processes in an international context, particularly timetabling, student records management, and faculty support.
  • Experience in organizing and managing institutional events, including student welcome events, graduation ceremonies, and industry engagement activities.
  • Knowledge of UK academic regulations related to attendance monitoring, student records management, and student retention.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

Language Skills

  • Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) both written and spoken, as the position is based in London and involves communication with an international audience.
  • Additional language skills are a plus

Terms of Employment

  • Salary Range: £29,000–£31,000, depending on experience
  • Contract: Full-time, fixed-term contract (12 months)
  • Start date: 1 September 2026
  • Working pattern: Onsite
  • Working hours: Typically Monday to Friday, with flexible working hours (e.g. 9:00–17:00 or 10:00–18:00). Occasional adjustments to working hours may be required to support student events and other institutional activities.
  • Starting Date: The successful candidate will join on 1 September to participate in the induction programme and support planning activities ahead of the start of the academic year.

Why Join NABA London?

Joining NABA London offers the opportunity to be part of the launch of a new international creative institution in London.

You will play a pivotal role in shaping an outstanding student experience by supporting the delivery of academic services and fostering a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive campus environment. Working within a collaborative and international team, you will contribute to building efficient processes, enhancing student wellbeing, and helping establish a vibrant academic community from its very beginning.

Display courageous leadership in getting all partners together with a Profit Driver Mindset.

title: Research Scientist – FTE - Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS)
description:
AstraZeneca is a global, science-driven biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative, meaningful medicines and healthcare solutions that enrich the lives of patients. Here you are encouraged and supported to think creatively in our dynamic environment, free from fear of failure, free to ask the right questions and make bold decisions.

Introduction to the role

We are currently looking for a laboratory analytical scientist in drug substance development. You will join our Early Chemical Development (ECD) group in Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS), Macclesfield Campus, UK.

The 101-acre Macclesfield is the biggest pharmaceutical manufacturing site in the UK, supported by over 3,000 employees. The campus is also home to Pharmaceutical Sciences and is the primary AstraZeneca site for Chemical Development capabilities.

Pharmaceutical Sciences is a function within the AstraZeneca Biopharmaceuticals R&D unit that creates innovative, efficient solutions by transforming molecules into investigative medicines meeting unmet needs of future patients. The function has five main science departments: Early Chemical Development (ECD), Small Molecule Product Discovery and Development (SMPDD), New Modality Product Discovery and Development (NMPDD), Drug Product Manufacture (DPM), and Predictive Science, Digital and Automation (PSDA). Our wide-ranging portfolio of projects includes traditional small molecules, nucleotide-based therapies and other novel modalities across AstraZeneca’s therapy areas.

Early Chemical Development is a world class CMC (chemistry manufacturing and control) department with responsibility for early phase Drug Substance. The department’s responsibilities span from early engagement with Discovery Chemistry groups to manufacture of Phase II Clinical material, and its key skill areas include Analytical Chemistry, Crystallisation, Isotope Chemistry, Large-Scale Laboratory (Kilo-Lab) Manufacturing, Process Chemistry, Process Design and Process Engineering.

When we put diverse teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of four days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

Job Description

We are currently looking for a scientist to join our analytical group within ECD. The group are dedicated to the development of control strategies and the accompanying analytical methods to enable the development of manufacturing routes and subsequent GMP release of clinical active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) at AstraZeneca.

We’re looking for a scientist who is enthusiastic, motivated, with scientific rigour and a strong desire to learn and push the boundaries of what we can do.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Development of robust analytical methodologies supporting the development of synthetic routes and processes and the release and stability analysis of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API)

  • Interpreting analytical data and drawing reliable conclusions and recommendations to influence future work

  • Developing the ECD analytical testing capabilities, including development and validation of analytical methodologies to support the drug substance portfolio.

  • Collaborating with synthetic chemists and external partners to drive our understanding of manufacturing processes and control strategies.

  • Using technical knowledge and understanding to contribute to improvement projects and the evaluation of state of the art technologies.

  • Utilising specialist scientific and/or technology networks within Pharmaceutical Sciences and beyond for project development and issue resolution

  • Sharing and presentation of work to foster a continued learning environment.

  • Ensure that work is in accordance with appropriate Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) guidelines, quality and compliance standards, e.g. Good Laboratory Practice (GLP).

Required Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Degree or equivalent in Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry (achieved or predicted 2:1 or higher), graduating in 2026 or in the last two years

  • Degree course must include significant synthetic organic and analytical chemistry content

  • Self-motivated and systematic approach to work and delivering to deadlines.

  • Great communication skills (written and spoken).

  • Evidence of ability to collaborate and work optimally within teams

  • Detailed approach to tasks with the ability to plan and deliver activities to deadlines

  • Rational and logical approach to decision making and problem solving, making judgements based on sound reasoning

  • Uses digital tools and laboratory systems confidently to analyse and share data, work efficiently, and support timely decision-making in early phase drug substance development.

  • Knowledge of a range of analytical techniques, e.g. Ultra/High Performance Liquid Chromatography, Mass Spectrometry, Gas Chromatography, NMR spectroscopy

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Evidence of innovative approaches to problem solving in order to overcome significant challenges

  • Relevant chemistry understanding applicable to enhance the application of analytical testing

  • Evidence of ability to collaborate and work optimally within teams.

Applications must include your current CV, and a cover letter which presents your motivation and suitability for the role.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Study Conduct/ Clinical Research Practice - Maintain awareness of status of all active studies. Arrange for facilities and supplies. Ensure participant and study compliance, i.e. collection of study specimens, and study visits. Work with study team as needed to define specimen collection, processing and storage procedures. Train others as needed to collect and label samples as instructed and deliver or process samples in accordance with the protocol, manual of operations, standard operating procedures (SOP) or other work instruction set. Ensure specimens are properly logged, handled and stored. Maintain all records and files required by regulatory agencies and sponsors. Serve as a resource for other clinical research professionals in all aspects of conducting a clinical trial. Collaborate with investigator(s) and coworkers to ensure proper progress and completion of clinical studies. Train new staff in preparation and conduct of clinical trials.

  • Regulatory Compliance and Documentation - Prepare, submit & maintain all regulatory submissions (proposed new studies, annual review, amendments, & adverse events) accurately & within a timely manner to all collaborative parties. Periodically self-audit records to ensure audit-readiness. Prepare, plan, & participate in all monitor visits, audits, & quality reviews (internal & external) in a professional manner. Oversee the review, correspondence & approval of human research protocols with all regulatory authorities, including study closeout. Determine which research protocols or issues have additional requirements, e.g. the need for review by additional divisions, regulatory agencies, or consultants, & coordinate the process to meet these requirements. Apply legal, regulatory & policy parameters to promote ethical practices in research involving human participants & to ensure compliance to those regulations. Document the conduct of each protocol's regulatory activities in appropriate systems. Maintain up-to-date & accurate written & electronic records & files to support clinical research activities. Continuously update knowledge of regulatory requirements. May act on behalf of the PI in communicating with sponsor, other divisions or institutions to coordinate studies & follow through on issues.

  • Recruitment/Enrollment/Retention - Determine best method/s to identify potential participants for research protocol (advertisements, chart reviews, monitoring of clinic schedule, etc.) and prepare accordingly. Create and maintain a detailed tracking system for participants considered for enrollment. Track progress at regular intervals and report out to PI and or management. Identify potentially eligible participants. Conduct pre-consent screening to determine eligibility. Review consent form with participant and provide time for participant to consider study participation. Execute the informed consent process according to GCP and CCHMC procedures and other applicable rules, regulations and policies. Communicate with participants' clinical team regarding study participation. Document in applicable systems (tracking, electronic health, etc.) participants approached, screened and enrolled in the study. Communicate challenges with recruitment and retention to the study leadership. Make recommendations to improve recruitment and retention to the study leadership. Engage study staff to assist in identifying and enrolling participants. Proactively identify and monitor barriers to recruitment and problem solve or innovate to overcome them.

  • Communication - Compose, document, organize, and maintain all correspondence. Oversee and follow through on questions and issues that arise during study conduct. Serve as CCHMC liaison to internal departments, clinical teams, regulatory agencies, physician's offices, city clinics, government agencies, academic centers, and other organizations. Communicate study related issues to investigators, sponsors, coordinating centers, study coordinators, clinical and research teams, managers and other institutions. Develop a rapport with study participants.

  • Data Management - Create CRFs in consultation with other team members, as needed, using existing study data information to promote efficient data collection and data entry. Complete Case Report Forms (CRFs) and source documentation in compliance with all applicable guidelines for human research. Review CRFs to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Clinical Practice. Review documentation from sources to ensure accuracy. Enter data into various auditable databases or electronic data-capture systems and/or oversee data entry and validation to ensure accuracy, completeness of data collection process. Perform data cleaning procedures and quality checks to ensure accuracy of data. Support the data-management process for clinical research projects, including addressing data queries from data managers, project statistician, and sponsors. Review reports, tables, and listings. Assist in data analysis and maintain record keeping and data storage for clinical research studies. Maintain master database files for clinical research protocols. Prepare reports from validation studies of clinical research projects.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician 1
description:
Job Description Summary

At our Salt Lake City site, engineering, research, and manufacturing teams come together to design and build surgical imaging technologies — including advanced C-arm imaging systems that support image-guided procedures for clinicians across the globe. The work here contributes to the precision and capability clinicians bring into the OR every day.

The Manufacturing Engineering Technician 1 supports manufacturing operations by partnering with engineers and production teams to keep the manufacturing floor running efficiently. This hands-on role troubleshoots equipment and process issues, supports assembly and test operations, collects and analyzes production data, and helps implement process improvements for advanced medical imaging systems. The position also plays a key role in maintaining manufacturing documentation, supporting new product introductions, and ensuring products are built to quality and regulatory standards.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Assist manufacturing engineers in the design, development, and improvement of production processes, fixtures, and tooling.

  • Perform basic troubleshooting of manufacturing equipment and processes, escalating complex issues to higher-level technicians or engineers.

  • Collect and analyze production data to identify areas for improvement and support process optimization initiatives.

  • Assist in the creation and maintenance of manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, process flow diagrams.

  • Conduct time studies and participate in lean manufacturing activities to improve efficiency and reduce waste.

  • Support the implementation and validation of new products and processes on the production floor.

  • Perform routine maintenance and calibration of manufacturing equipment as directed.

  • Adhere to all safety guidelines and quality standards (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA regulations).

  • Collaborate with production personnel to resolve manufacturing issues and ensure smooth operations.

  • Participate in root cause analysis for production defects and non-conformances.


Required Qualifications

  • Associate's degree in a technical field (e.g., Manufacturing Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology) or High School diploma and minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role in a manufacturing environment.

  • Basic understanding of manufacturing processes and equipment.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and blueprints.

  • Proficiency with basic hand tools and measurement equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers).

  • Basic computer skills, including familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel).

  • Physical ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand for extended periods.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in a medical device or electronics industry.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow precise instructions.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

title: Statistical Programmer II
description:
Job Title: Statistical Programmer II

  • Career Level – C

  • Location: Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore

  • Shift: 9 AM -6 PM IST, Hybrid (3 days a week in office)

  • Experience required: 2 to 4 years.

This is what you will do:

The Statistical Programmer II will provide programming support for the development and validation of programs which create datasets conforming to Alexion and CDISC standards, as well as Tables, Listings, and Figures (“TLFs”) for analysis purpose. This role will develop specifications to ensure that statistical programming elements are in line with the overall deliverable and ensure adherence to ICH guidelines, Good Clinical Practices, and regulatory requirements. This role must demonstrate, at a minimum, an ability to understand statistical concepts with SAS Programming in a most efficient and effective manner. The Statistical Programmer II is primarily responsible for providing support to deliver technical programming and information components of moderate scope and medium complexity studies or drug projects. It will act as a contributor on cross-functional teams to deliver continuous improvement. This role works under the general direction and support of an experienced programmer.


You will be responsible for:

  • Under guidance, support development of technical programming specifications for SDTM, ADS or ADaM standards

  • Under guidance develop and/or validate programs that generate SDTM datasets, analysis datasets based on Alexion or ADaM specifications and tables, listings, figures/graphs based on Protocol and SAP

  • Understands the contents of protocols and clinical development plans to understand contribution of their work

  • Work within established frameworks and ensures high quality is built into own deliverables

  • Work independently for well-defined scope of work

  • Continue to acquire knowledge of drug development process

  • Continue to increase knowledge of SAS

  • Continue to increase knowledge of industry standards

  • Take steps to understand the roles and skills of others in clinical study teams

  • Take steps to understand the roles and skills of other functions in drug development

  • Proactively keeps the lead programmer updated on progress of deliveries

  • Collaborate with external vendors and contract programmers

  • Provide project progress updates of programming activities

  • Support project leadership ensuring that department standards are implemented in all studies

  • Contribute ideas and thoughts towards the optimization of standard operating procedures

  • Any other activities as required.

The duties of this role are generally conducted in an office environment. As is typical of an office-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours.


You will need to have:

  • 2 to 4 years of statistical programming experience in the Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or Contract Research Industry.

  • Ability to understand the concepts of development and validation of technical specifications and programs for safety and efficacy analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures/graphs.

  • Work collaboratively to resolve problems

  • Clearly communicate with management and team members

  • Understanding and basic competence in using SAS/Base, SAS/Macro, SAS/STAT. or other statistical computing software.

  • Basic understanding of:

  • Relational Databases.

  • Good Programming practices


Why Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease: Here your programming turns into real-world impact, with the speed and focus of a biotech coupled with the scale and stability of a global biopharma. You will work close to the science and even closer to the questions that matter, surrounded by colleagues who value kindness alongside ambition. Expect an environment where unexpected teams share the same room to unleash bold thinking, where standards, automation, and learning are invested in, and where your growth is tied to the difference we make for people with serious conditions. We blend flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration, and support smart ways of working so you can do your best work.

Call to Action: Bring your SAS expertise and curiosity to a team where your code shortens the path from data to decision—take the next step and apply today!

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. To fully experience our collaborative, in‑person environment, candidates who are not based in the job location will need to relocate. In line with our company policy, relocation support is offered for moves within the country, ensuring a smooth transition. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

We are more than a health system. We are a belief system. We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Provides general nursing care to patients and families throughout the continuum of care in diverse, acute health care settings. (Department has scheduled staff to operate 24/7/365).

The RN accountable for the practice of nursing as defined by the Ohio Board of Nursing.

Operations (10%).

Platform Administration & Governance

For more than 55 years, Family Health Centers of San Diego’s (FHCSD) mission has been to provide caring, affordable, high-quality health care and supportive services to everyone, with a special commitment to uninsured, low-income and medically underserved persons.

FHCSD is one of the top 10 largest federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the country. We operate more than 90 sites across San Diego County, including 29 primary care clinics, 23 behavioral health facilities, 10 physical rehabilitation clinics, nine dental clinics, five vision clinics, four outpatient substance use treatment programs, three mobile medical units, two mobile counseling centers, two urgent care centers, and a pharmacy.

Our staff provides care to over 227,000 patients each year, of whom 91% are low-income and 29% are uninsured. FHCSD provides care to all. Services include, but are not limited to adult care, chronic disease management, pediatrics, comprehensive women’s care including obstetrics, dental, vision, case management, physical rehabilitation, speech therapy for children, vaccinations, infectious diseases, behavioral health, substance use counseling and a host of specialty services including cardiology, podiatry, endocrinology, dermatology, among others. FHCSD also offers supportive services to those who are unsheltered and in need of intensive case management.

The breadth of our clinic locations, services and programs has grown over the last five decades, making us the largest community clinic provider of health care to the uninsured in the county and one of the top 10 largest community clinic organizations in the nation. We are also the largest health care safety-net provider, largest school-based health care provider and the largest mental health provider in the San Diego region.

title: IV Tech
description:
IV Tech

Location: Geneva, IL

Company: IV Nutrition

About the Role

We are hiring an IV Infusion Technician to deliver high-quality IV therapy services while supporting daily clinic operations and client experience.

This role is responsible for executing IV treatments, maintaining clinical standards, and ensuring every client receives safe, efficient, and professional care.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role with a clear path to leadership. High performers will have the opportunity to grow into an Assistant Clinic Director position.

What You’ll Do

Clinical Care & Execution

  • Start IVs and administer IM injections safely and efficiently
  • Monitor clients during treatment to ensure comfort and safety
  • Document treatments, client responses, and clinical notes accurately
  • Maintain strict adherence to clinical protocols and safety standards

Client Experience

  • Create a welcoming, professional environment for all clients
  • Educate clients on therapies, supplements, and wellness benefits
  • Communicate clearly and build trust with clients throughout their visit
  • Address client questions and concerns with professionalism and empathy

Clinic Operations

  • Prepare IV drips and manage treatment flow throughout the day
  • Track, manage, and restock inventory as needed
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of clinical areas
  • Support scheduling and overall clinic efficiency

Team Support & Execution

  • Work closely with Clinic Director and Assistant Director
  • Support team goals and daily operational priorities
  • Assist with training and onboarding as needed
  • Contribute to a positive, team-focused work environment

Growth & Leadership Development

  • Demonstrate accountability, initiative, and strong work ethic
  • Participate in team meetings, training, and development
  • Take ownership of responsibilities beyond basic role expectations
  • Become eligible for promotion to Assistant Clinic Director after 90-day performance review

Qualifications

  • Active __ license required

Certifications

  • IV Therapy Certification
  • CPR/BLS certification

Experience

  • 1+ year of clinical, emergency, or infusion experience preferred

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong IV and injection skills
  • Excellent bedside manner and client care approach
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • High attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Calm, professional, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • Strong work ethic and reliability
  • Interest in wellness, preventative care, and functional medicine

Compensation & Growth

  • Hourly Pay: $20–$30/hour + tips + commissions
  • Performance-based pay increase after 90 days
  • Clear path to Assistant Clinic Director role based on performance

Working Conditions

  • Full-time position with clinic-based schedule
  • 5-10 hour shifts, including some weekends as needed
  • Clinic environment with direct client interaction

Is This Role For You?

Who This Role Is For

  • Someone who enjoys hands-on client care
  • A team player who thrives in a fast-paced clinic environment
  • An individual looking to grow into a leadership role
  • Someone who values structure, consistency, and client experience

What This Role Is Not For

  • Someone uncomfortable with high-volume IV starts
  • Someone who prefers non-client-facing roles
  • Someone who struggles with multitasking or fast-paced environments
  • Someone not interested in growth or advancement

Reality Check

You will be starting IVs all day.

Clients will vary in difficulty. Some will be anxious. Some will require extra attention.

You are responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality experience every time.

If you are not confident in your IV skills or do not enjoy fast-paced, hands-on clinical work, this role will not be a fit.

title: Lead Engineer - System Engineering
description:
Job Description Summary

The Lead Engineer is responsible for ensuring the operational readiness, performance, and regulatory compliance of Molecular Imaging (MI) systems, including PET/CT and SPECT/CT platforms, within an engineering lab environment. This role supports engineering, installation, calibration, verification & validation, and development teams by maintaining imaging systems, handling radioactive materials, managing lab infrastructure, and ensuring adherence to radiation safety, EHS, and quality standards. The technician plays a key role in minimizing system downtime and enabling seamless lab operations across multiple systems.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference — and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain PET/CT and SPECT/CT systems, ensuring system readiness, uptime, and optimal performance across multiple scanner bays.

  • Perform system installation, mechanical, electrical, calibration, alignment, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle support to ensure reliable system performance.

  • Maintain system components, perform repairs and replacements, and ensure systems are updated with approved software and firmware version.

  • Support engineering activities, including system configuration, test setup, execution, and data acquisition for validation.

  • Execute laboratory and validation testing, including inspection and system performance verification.

  • Troubleshoot system issues, perform root cause analysis, and apply technical judgment to implement effective corrective actions.

  • Handle, store, track lifecycle, and dispose radioactive materials, sources, and phantoms in compliance with safety regulations, working closely with RSO.

  • Ensure compliance with EHS and radiation safety standards, maintaining documentation and supporting audits in coordination with RSO.

  • Maintain and enhance MI lab infrastructure, collaborating with facility teams for upkeep of scanner bays, engineering systems, and environmental conditions.

  • Support design, setup, and continuous improvement of MI lab infrastructure, test facilities, and instrumentation systems.

  • Manage spare parts lifecycle including ordering, tracking, import/export coordination, customs clearance, and warehouse storage in collaboration with logistics teams.

  • Maintain accurate documentation in alignment with GEHC QMS, EHS, including maintenance records, calibration data, SRA, and SOPs

  • Drive operational excellence by improving system reliability, uptime, and adherence to GEHC quality and safety standards

  • Develop in-depth technical expertise in molecular imaging systems and subsystems, contributing to continuous improvement

  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams and provide guidance to junior team members to support overall program objectives

Educational Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Biomedical Engineering, or Nuclear Medicine Technology.

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with medical imaging systems (PET/SPECT preferred)

  • Knowledge of radiation safety protocols and regulatory compliance

  • Experience in equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, installation, and calibration

  • Experience in software installation, upgrades, and system configuration

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

title: Staff Software Engineer – Interoperability & Cybersecurity
description:
Job Description Summary

Join an exciting software development team focused on connected medical devices. In this role you will design and develop data connectivity, interoperability, and secure software solutions for devices that acquire and exchange critical patient information in real time, with additional responsibilities in UI development and system integration.

About Us
The Maternal Infant Care team is developing the future of medical technology for Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and Labor & Delivery environments. Our mission is to help send mothers and infants home healthy by building safe, reliable, and connected medical devices that support critical clinical care.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for embedded software of next generation medical devices in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and Labor and Delivery space.
  • Work closely with a team of Software Engineers and across disciplines (Electrical Engineers, Systems Engineers, etc.) to translate system architecture and product requirements into well-designed software components.
  • Work in a fast paced, AI enhanced agile-scrum development environment.
  • Conduct technical design reviews to ensure the software meets security, reliability, and performance requirements.
  • Develop integrated software products with uncompromised quality (includes the use of static analysis tools, design reviews, code reviews).
  • Seek and provide feedback on design and development through collaboration with software architects and platform teams.
  • Design features with input from system architecture and product requirements to produce detailed architecture, detailed design, and software implementation.
  • Implement solutions that are aligned with and extend shared platforms and solutions.
  • Ensure compliance to quality practices and medical device standards for design and development.
  • Research new AI tools, technologies, and methodologies to keep our software on the cutting edge.
  • Understand the entire product, its modules, and the interrelationship between them while being an expert in the assigned component or module.

Qualifications & Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related STEM major with a minimum of 6 years of work experience as a software engineer in a product development team.
  • 2+ years of experience in data connectivity, communication protocols, and system integration including HL7, FHIR, and healthcare interoperability standards.
  • 1+ year of experience developing and supporting HL7-based interfaces and healthcare data exchange workflows.
  • 1+ year of experience designing secure connected systems including authentication, encryption, secure communication, and device/network hardening.
  • Experience with cloud connectivity, IoMT architectures, and device-to-system data exchange.
  • Experience with UI/application layer development (e.g., Qt, web-based UI, or other frameworks) to support data visualization and user interaction.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, Design patterns, Algorithms and data structures.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Desired Skills – Technical

  • Strong analytical skills, with excellent problem-solving abilities and experience creating flexible code.
  • Experience with FHIR APIs, RESTful services, and modern healthcare interoperability frameworks.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and hospital system integration (EHR, EMR, LIS, PACS).
  • Understanding of data integrity, traceability, and auditability in regulated healthcare systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting real-world integration issues (message failures, latency, mismatched schemas, etc.).
  • Familiarity with healthcare data privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR where applicable).
  • Experience with event-driven architectures for clinical data exchange.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining engineering rigor.
  • Strong understanding of threat modeling, risk assessments, and vulnerability management for connected systems.
  • Knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) concepts, including certificate-based authentication and role-based access control.
  • Familiarity with security standards and guidance for medical devices (e.g., FDA cybersecurity guidance, NIST frameworks).
  • Experience performing or supporting penetration testing, static/dynamic analysis, and security audits.
  • Knowledge of secure communication protocols (TLS, HTTPS, MQTT over TLS, VPNs).
  • Experience designing systems with defense-in-depth architectures and minimizing attack surfaces.
  • Awareness of cyber incident response, logging, monitoring, and forensic readiness.

Company Overview

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

A Presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025. These part-time Adjunct Faculty positions are designed to support our growing student enrollment for the 2025-2026 Academic Year at our Stephenville, Fort Worth, and Waco campuses. Successful candidates may teach up to six (6) semester credit hours in their respective disciplines, delivering instruction in person, through approved instructional modalities, or as necessitated by student demand. Additionally, they will be expected to hold office hours and provide necessary support to students. Serves as a Campus Security Authority (CSA).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

100% Teaching:

  • Plan, prepare, and deliver lectures, seminars, and/or laboratory offerings to undergraduate and/or graduate students, which may include general education core curriculum.

  • Develop course syllabi, select instructional materials, and design assessments such as exams, quizzes, papers, etc.

  • Assess student performance, provide timely feedback, and evaluate student learning outcomes to inform teaching practices and curriculum improvements.

  • Engage students in active learning, foster critical thinking skills, and provide opportunities for discussion, collaboration, and hands-on learning.

  • Provide academic support and guidance to students through office hours, feedback on assignments, and mentoring.

  • Adhere to university policies, academic integrity standards, and accreditation requirements related to teaching responsibilities.

  • Incorporate innovative teaching methods, technologies, and pedagogical approaches to enhance student learning and engagement.

Other information:

  • Adjunct Faculty positions are temporary appointments, assigned per semester and on an as-needed basis.

  • These temporary appointments are for the Academic Year 2025-2026 sub-terms.

Required Qualifications:

  • Earned masters degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited university with a minimum of 18 graduate hours in the teaching discipline, and two years post-MSW experience.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Earned doctorate/terminal degree in the discipline or a closely related field from an accredited university with a minimum of 18 graduate hours in the teaching discipline.

  • Previous online teaching experience at the collegiate level.

  • Preferred appropriate professional certifications and/or licenses.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Knowledge and understanding of disciplinary subject matter at a level adequate for undergraduate and graduate-level instruction; written and oral communication skills sufficient to conduct effective teaching activities; ability to interact with students, staff, and faculty in a professional, collegial, and collaborative manner.

***Commensurate with experience***

Application Procedure:

During the application process applicants have one opportunity to enter the requested information, upload documents, and Submit the application. Applicants will not be able to make changes or add additional documents once the application materials have been submitted via the "Submit" action.

Employment applications must include (required):

  • Completed online application

  • Cover Letter / Letter of Interest addressing qualifications

  • Curriculum Vitae or Resume

  • At least 3 current professional references and their full contact information

  • Unofficial transcripts

Applications received by Tarleton State University must have all job application data entered. Failure to provide all job application data could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. “See resume” is not an acceptable entry in the job application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.

Official transcripts must be received directly from each degree‐granting institution prior to a letter of appointment being issued.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

title: SFDK Warehouse Attendant $18.50/HR
description:
Overview

Enjoy the perks of being a Six Flags Team member! Get free admission to all Six Flags Theme Parks, free tickets for friends and family, access to exclusive employee events, and discounts. As a warehouse associate, you will support the Warehouse in receiving, shipping, invoice processing, stocking, locating, pick and distribution of supplies, materials and souvenirs from the warehouse and outside vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, stock, locate, and distribute supplies, gifts, souvenirs for the Park from outside vendors.
  • Process vendor invoices including matching invoices to delivery receipts by verifying prices, tax, and expense coding, match up paperwork with purchase orders and receiving memos.
  • Unload stock from delivery trucks using a hand truck, pallet jack, or other related equipment.
  • Complete periodic inventory of the Warehouse stock and assist with Park Wide Inventories.
  • Deliver gifts, souvenirs and other supplies stored in the Warehouse to the Retail Stores, Food Locations, and Offices in the Park.
  • Use Company Inventory Programs and other computer programs as required.
  • Support Park safety programs and other Park policies and procedures.
  • Perform any function that may be delegated by a Warehouse Manager, Supervisor, or Lead.
  • Other duties as requested.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license.
  • Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • High School Education or GED preferred.
  • Must be able to work weekends, weekdays, Holidays, early or evening shifts as assigned.
  • Must possess the mental and physical capacities necessary to perform the primary job duties. Must be able to sit, stand, and walk for long periods of time. Must be able to lift up to 60lbs with or without assistance.
  • Must be able to safely maneuver a hand truck, pallet jack, and other related equipment after instruction.
  • Must greet guests and fellow team members in a friendly manner.

description:
