Job Summary:


The Care Coordinator RN (CC RN) is responsible for assessing transitional care needs, coordinating care across the continuum, and engaging with patient and family to assure care needs are met. The CC RN plans effectively to meet the patient's needs, manage the length of stay and promote efficient utilization of resources. Overall, the role integrates and coordinates care facilitation, care progression and transitional care planning functions.
Specific functions within this role include:
Psychosocial and functional status assessment, transitional care planning, clinical care progression, facilitate patient/family care conferences, participate in interdisciplinary rounds, and patient/family education
Collaborates effectively with the utilization review nurse, patient's physicians and the interdisciplinary care team to provide a comprehensive assessment of the patient's medical care needs, psychosocial needs, any social determinants of health needs, goals/outcome attainment and continued care needs
Assures that the patient is progressing towards their discharge goal and assists to alleviate barriers
Seeks consultation from appropriate disciplines/departments as required to proactively identify and resolve delays to expedite care and facilitate discharge.
May have other duties assigned


Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:


Assessment
* Based on preliminary screening of patients, initiates assessment of patients chronic disease management needs and psychosocial risk factors and availability of resources to assist upon discharge.
* Partners with the PAS, financial counselor and/or UM nurse to assess insurance and coverage requirements for all payers to ensure adherence to those requirements.
* Collaborates with the patient and family, along with the physician(s) and other members of the care team to fully establish and support both the patients care progression and discharge plans..
* Meets with physicians and care team routinely to collaborate on timely and efficient patient management.
Disposition Planning
* Manages all aspects of discharge planning for assigned patients.
* Implements discharge planning timely and provides resources in an efficient manner.
* Meets with patient/family to assess needs and develop an individualized discharge plan in collaboration with physicians.
* Identifies and documents barriers for timely disposition.
* Ensures/maintains discharge plan consensus with patient/family, physicians, care teams and payers.
* Responds to referrals for patients post-acute needs from physicians and the care team.
* Participates in Interdisciplinary Rounds with the patients care team to confirm estimated date of discharge and make recommendations for best level of care transition at discharge.
* Initiates/facilitates post-acute referrals through departmental processes for timely transition to the next level of care.
* Refer appropriate cases for social work intervention based on departmental protocol.
* Allows for any cultural or religious beliefs in providing service and continuity of care.
Care Progression
* Collaborates with physicians and care team to facilitate communication regarding patients care progression to ensure timely and efficient delivery of care.
* Proactively identifies delays/obstacles in diagnostic or treatments within the plan of care which can lead to discharge delays.
* Identities and discusses with physician the medical necessity for inpatient testing that may be more appropriate in the outpatient setting.
* Actively works to resolve barriers to discharge and engages/escalates barriers to discharge to the appropriate leader for efficient resolution
Documentation
* Initial clinical/psychosocial assessment completed and documented in medical record.
* Ensure all records are up-to-date and documentation is clear and concise.
* Ensure timely and accurate documentation in progress notes of interactions with patient/family, physicians, care team, and community partners as it pertains to the patients discharge plan.
* Accounts for and indicates all services arranged/delivered in electronic medical record.
* Track avoidable days and report trends that lead to undesired outcomes.
Professional Development and Initiative
* Completes all initial and ongoing professional competency assessment, required mandatory education, population specific education.
* Supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization.
* Serves as a preceptor and/or mentor for student interns (if appropriate)
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

  • Associates Nursing or Diploma (Nurse) Nursing or Bachelors Nursing-Preferred

All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.

  • RN - Reg Nurse (Single State) or RN-COMPACT - RN - Multi-state Compact
  • BLS - Basic Life Support or ARC-BLS - Amer Red Cross Basic Life Support or BLS-I - Basic Life Support - Instructor


Required Minimum Experience:


Minimum 1 year nursing experience in the acute care setting. Required

Excellent written and verbal communication skill.
Must possess maturity, self-confidence, objectivity, and positive attitude.
Self-directed with the ability to function well under stress, handle change, and function in a fast-paced environment
Strong assessment, interview, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge regarding local, state and federal regulations required.
Knowledge of community and state-wide resources and programs.
Ability to work collaboratively with physicians, members of the care team, and the patient/family to assist with progression of care through their transition to the next level of care.

The Laboratory Technical Supervisor is primarily responsible for the specific section or discipline that he or she is assigned. They are the designated Subject Matter Experts in the discipline to which they are assigned. They are also responsible for maintaining accreditation readiness within the department. Additional responsibilities include all Human Resource functions including scheduling, payroll, and performance evaluations, etc.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Technical Oversight
Demonstrates current theoretical knowledge and critical thinking skills to be applied to area of expertise. Works directly with the Pathologists as principle investigator for area (s) of expertise researching new assays, recalls, errors. Determines rules and algorithms used to maintain acceptable parameters for test verification. Analyzes statistical data such as variance, mean, coefficient of variation, and interpret graphs and charts to insure accuracy of test data. Assures readiness for accreditation inspections.
Maintains analyzers in peak condition. Troubleshoots equipment malfunctions. May stop production until remedial action is successful in restoring quality results. May initiate equipment repair and validate functionality. May provide data for restoration of equipment and procedures to all accrediting agencies. Manages assays to provide optimal patient results. Performs or assigns for completion all correlations, linearity, calibrations, and parallel studies in accordance with established written standards of accrediting agencies and legal institutions. Assists in procedural selections and analyzer selection processes. Implements new methods in accordance to established written standards. Troubleshoots procedural breakdowns. Manages recalls as needed.
Demonstrates technical competence and can perform all analyses in area of expertise. Assists other technologists, technicians and assistants with the interpretation of test results and test run accuracy. Maintains all aspects of quality control and maintains required documentation. Attends specialty schools and training programs to learn all aspects of discipline such as Hematology, Chemistry, Molecular diagnostics, Microbiology, Urinalysis, Coagulation, Immunohematology or other lab diagnostic specialty. Works the bench as needed.

Serves others from a team-centered approach. Leads current Wellstar engagement program.

description:
For more than 55 years, Family Health Centers of San Diego’s (FHCSD) mission has been to provide caring, affordable, high-quality health care and supportive services to everyone, with a special commitment to uninsured, low-income and medically underserved persons.

FHCSD is one of the top 10 largest federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the country. We operate more than 90 sites across San Diego County, including 29 primary care clinics, 23 behavioral health facilities, 10 physical rehabilitation clinics, nine dental clinics, five vision clinics, four outpatient substance use treatment programs, three mobile medical units, two mobile counseling centers, two urgent care centers, and a pharmacy.

Our staff provides care to over 227,000 patients each year, of whom 91% are low-income and 29% are uninsured. FHCSD provides care to all. Services include, but are not limited to adult care, chronic disease management, pediatrics, comprehensive women’s care including obstetrics, dental, vision, case management, physical rehabilitation, speech therapy for children, vaccinations, infectious diseases, behavioral health, substance use counseling and a host of specialty services including cardiology, podiatry, endocrinology, dermatology, among others. FHCSD also offers supportive services to those who are unsheltered and in need of intensive case management.

The breadth of our clinic locations, services and programs has grown over the last five decades, making us the largest community clinic provider of health care to the uninsured in the county and one of the top 10 largest community clinic organizations in the nation. We are also the largest health care safety-net provider, largest school-based health care provider and the largest mental health provider in the San Diego region.

Family Health Centers of San Diego (FHCSD) is looking for Substance Use Disorder Counselor (SUDC) - Registered provides substance abuse screening, brief interventions, therapy for individuals and groups, and coordinates referrals for patients. Responsibilities also include providing leadership and training to staff related to chemical dependency issues, and serving as a subject matter expert in the cross-functional treatment team. Depending on assignment, the SUDC may be working with patients living with serious mental illness, HIV, or homelessness.

Responsibilities:

  • Completes all required documentation accurately, in a timely manner, and thoroughly in accordance with department standards; in addition, documentation complies with patients' insurance requirements.

  • Develops and maintains community resources information and contacts related to assigned patient population. Acts as a liaison and may provide consultations with community agencies.

  • Participates in the design and implementation of mental health and substance abuse service delivery, working closely with multi-disciplinary team to ensure continuity of care.

  • Provides direct substance abuse counseling services, including crisis intervention and individual, group, and family counseling, targeting assigned patient population groups experiencing substance abuse/dependency disorders. Provides support and assistance to maintain patients' treatment and recovery.

  • Provides substance abuse education and referral information to patients, families, and other staff members in the areas of substance abuse counseling and treatment services.

  • Provides substance abuse screening and assessments. Participates in the development of patients' individualized care plans. Assesses patients' need for enrollment in medical, self-help programs, outpatient services, and/or residential facilities and makes referrals, if necessary.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Registered Intern status from a California State Substance Use Disorders (SUD) Services certifying agency required

  • High School diploma (or GED equivalent) required.

  • Current American Heart Association healthcare provider CPR (BLS), or Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Advanced Trauma Life Support, or Advance Resuscitation Training required.

  • 1 year experience in providing counseling required; 2 years of experience providing counseling to assigned patient demographics, such as patients diagnosed with serious mental illness or HIV, preferred.

  • Bilingual English/Spanish may be required depending on site/location.

  • Traveling between sites and other locations is occasionally required. Must have a valid California driver’s license, an automobile, and proof of minimum levels of car insurance as required under California law, although limits of $100,000 are recommended. An acceptable driving record is also required. California law requires all drivers to obtain a valid California driver’s license within ten days of establishing residency. Reasonable accommodation may be provided on a case-by-case basis. Mileage and other reimbursement governed by policy.

  • Paid Time Off, Extended Sick Leave and Paid Holidays

  • Medical/Dental/Vision/FSA/Life Insurance

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Equipment Maintenance
description:
Job Description Summary

As an Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving manufacturing equipment within the Tube Loading Facility (TLF), supporting the production of X-ray tubes. You will drive equipment reliability, maximize machine uptime, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and partner with maintenance technicians to ensure safe and efficient manufacturing operations. This role offers the opportunity to work across a diverse range of specialized manufacturing equipment while contributing to continuous improvement, Lean initiatives, and future equipment installations.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Own the maintenance and reliability of approximately 40 production machines within the Tube Loading Facility (TLF).

  • Plan, schedule, and execute preventive maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability and reliability.

  • Diagnose equipment failures and perform breakdown troubleshooting to restore production quickly and safely.

  • Support the installation, qualification, commissioning, and validation of new manufacturing equipment.

  • Monitor equipment performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives to achieve and sustain greater than 95% machine uptime.

  • Collaborate closely with maintenance technicians by providing technical guidance, coaching, and problem-solving support.

  • Identify opportunities for equipment upgrades, process improvements, and reliability enhancements.

  • Support Lean manufacturing initiatives that improve operational efficiency and equipment performance.

  • Ensure compliance with all Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements and departmental standards.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance documentation, equipment history, and technical records.

  • Learn and support specialized manufacturing equipment through technical documentation, engineering drawings, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience in equipment maintenance within a manufacturing environment.

  • Hands-on experience with preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and maintenance planning.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electro-mechanical manufacturing equipment.

  • Working knowledge of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC).

  • Experience supporting industrial equipment such as vacuum systems, furnaces, heat-treatment equipment, welding systems, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), motors, or similar manufacturing equipment.

  • Ability to interpret technical manuals, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation to diagnose and resolve equipment issues.

  • Strong commitment to equipment safety, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Desired Characteristics

  • Exposure to SCADA and/or LabVIEW systems.

  • Experience with equipment qualification, commissioning, or implementation projects.

  • Knowledge of temperature-control systems, sensors, limit switches, induction motors, or oil-heating systems.

  • Strong analytical and root cause problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technicians and cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Continuous improvement mindset with experience supporting Lean manufacturing initiatives.

title: Intermediate Transportation Modeller (Micro-Modelling)
location: Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA), Ontario, ca
description:
We are seeking a Transportation Modeller specialized in micro-modelling and simulation-based modelling to join our urban transportation team in Canada. In this pivotal role, you will lead the development and implementation of sophisticated transport modelling solutions that shape the future of urban mobility across the region. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with practical expertise in transportation systems, delivering data-driven insights that inform infrastructure development and policy decisions.

  • Develop, calibrate, and validate advanced transport models using industry-standard software (VISSIM, SYNCHRO, SIDRA, ARCADY, DYNAMEQ, AIMSUN, or similar platforms) to analyze traffic operation conditions, junctions and network performance.
  • Utilize and update transport models to assess the impacts of road closures and construction detour plans at corridor and junction levels.
  • Coordinate the modelling work and data exchange between strategic models and micro-level simulation models.
  • Conduct comprehensive transportation studies including transportation master plans, traffic management plans, traffic impact assessments, corridor studies, active transport plans and parking studies.
  • Analyze complex transportation data sets and synthesize findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Design and execute scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of proposed transport interventions, policy changes, and infrastructure investments.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, urban planners, and government agencies to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
  • Prepare detailed technical reports, presentations, and visualizations that communicate modelling results and planning recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stay current with emerging transport planning and traffic engineering methodologies, modelling tools, and best practices in the industry.
  • Mentor junior modellers and contribute to the professional development of the team.
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables while maintaining the highest standards of quality and accuracy.
  • Participate in stakeholder engagement sessions and public consultations to gather input and communicate planning initiatives.

Required:

  • University Degree in Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering or relevant field.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in micro-level transportation modelling, traffic engineering, and / or related traffic engineering and infrastructure planning roles.
  • Advanced proficiency with transport modeling software such as VISSIM, SYNCHRO, SIDRA, ARCADY, DYNAMEQ, AIMSUN, and / or equivalent platforms
  • Strong expertise in junction modelling, traffic simulation, and network analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with CAD, GIS software and data analysis.
  • Excellent project management capabilities with proven ability to deliver complex assignments on schedule.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Solid understanding of traffic engineering principles, urban mobility concepts, and transportation policies.

Preferred:

  • Experience working on transportation projects in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA).
  • Experience with construction traffic management and modelling detour plans.
  • Familiarity with public transportation planning and integrated mobility solutions.
  • Knowledge of sustainable transport initiatives and environmental impact assessment.
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages or data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and statistical software (Python, R, SQL, or similar).
  • Professional registration / certification in transportation planning or traffic engineering.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships.
  • Background in urban planning or civil engineering complementing transport modelling expertise.

description:
Junior Mechanical Designer is an entry-level engineering role based in Markham, Ontario, Canada, focused on the design and assessment of building mechanical systems within a multidisciplinary project environment.

The position supports the delivery of HVAC and building services design through the preparation of engineering calculations, technical documentation, 2D drawings, and 3D building models. Responsibilities span mechanical design development, equipment research, supplier coordination, technical reporting, and design documentation. The role provides exposure to multiple project phases, including design development, engineering analysis, interdisciplinary coordination, and project delivery.

The ideal candidate holds a Mechanical Engineering degree and demonstrates a strong foundation in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer. Exposure to building systems design, drafting technologies, engineering calculations, and collaborative project environments will support success in this role while contributing to ongoing professional development.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform heating and cooling load calculations and support HVAC system design analysis for building projects.
  • Assist with ductwork sizing and piping system design in accordance with project requirements and engineering standards.
  • Prepare detailed mechanical design drawings using AutoCAD and develop Building Information Modeling (BIM) content using Autodesk Revit.
  • Develop and maintain engineering calculators and design spreadsheets to improve design efficiency and technical accuracy.
  • Coordinate with equipment suppliers to obtain technical specifications, product data, and equipment selection information.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering sketches, drawing mark-ups, and project documentation under the direction of senior engineers.
  • Support multidisciplinary design coordination and contribute to project delivery schedules across multiple assignments.
  • Conduct technical research and engineering analysis to support mechanical system design decisions.
  • Participate in site visits and field investigations as required to support project execution and design verification.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable codes, standards, software platforms, and industry best practices relevant to building mechanical systems.
  • Perform additional project-related engineering and design support activities as required.

    Required

    • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university.
    • Foundational knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer principles.
    • Understanding of HVAC system fundamentals and building mechanical services design.
    • Experience through academic projects, co-op placements, internships, or related exposure to AutoCAD.
    • Experience through academic projects, co-op placements, internships, or related exposure to Autodesk Revit.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including engineering calculations and spreadsheet development.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reporting and stakeholder coordination.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments and meet project deadlines.
    • Ability to work in-office a minimum of three days per week.
    • Ability to visit project sites as required.
    • Years of Experience: 0–2 years of relevant academic, internship, co-op, or professional experience.

    Assets

    • Academic or internship experience within the buildings engineering or MEP consulting sector.
    • Exposure to Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows and model coordination processes.
    • Experience developing automated engineering spreadsheets, formulas, or calculation tools.
    • Familiarity with mechanical equipment selection and manufacturer technical documentation.
    • Exposure to multidisciplinary building design projects involving architectural and electrical disciplines.

Associate Director, Research Policy

Agency

Texas A&M University System Offices

Department

Research Compliance Office

Commensurate

Job Location

Dallas, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

The System Offices is one of several system members within the Texas A&M University System representing one of the largest systems of higher education in the nation, with a network of 12 universities, a comprehensive health science center, eight state agencies, Texas A&M – Fort Worth and the Texas A&M - RELLIS Campus. The Texas A&M University System mission is to provide education, conduct research, commercialize technology, offer training, and deliver services for the people of Texas and beyond.

The System Offices, within the Texas A&M University System, provides an outstanding benefits package including, but not limited to: competitive health benefits; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; a defined benefit retirement plan to include an employer contribution through Teachers Retirement System of Texas (TRS); if applicable, a defined contribution retirement plan to include an employer contribution through an approved ORP vendor: additional voluntary tax deferred annuity (TDA) options; tuition assistance; and wellness programs to promote work/life balance.

Salary:

Commensurate with experience.

Job Description Summary:

The Associate Director, Research Policy is responsible for tracking and analyzing new state and federal laws, regulations, guidelines, policies, and other actions that impact research in a timely manner with an emphasis on System member needs and communicate new state and federal laws, regulations guidelines, policies and other actions that impact research to the Vice Chancellor for Research and relevant A&M System stakeholders in an effective and timely manner. The Associate Director will also manage the operationalization of any needed policy or process changes to address new and emerging regulatory or guidance changes.


Responsibilities:
- Track and analyze new state and federal laws, regulations, guidelines, policies, and other actions that impact research in a timely manner with an emphasis on System member needs.

- Communicate new state and federal laws, regulations guidelines, policies and other actions that impact research to the Vice Chancellor for Research and relevant A&M System stakeholders in an effective and timely manner.

- Coordinate closely with the Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research to develop appropriate responses and action plans based on gap analyses and risk profiles;

- Prioritize responses and action plans based on potential impact.

- Draft, review, and revise, where appropriate, policy and guidance documents for the System and/or its members.

- Develop reports, metrics, and dashboards for senior System leadership.

- Coordinate with respective subject matter experts and cross-functional leaders within the System to recommend, develop, implement, and operationalize changes to research policies and processes to address new legal, regulatory, or funding agency policies.

- Monitor the research funding and compliance landscape for potential emerging policy trends to ensure System and member readiness.

- Assess compliance with System research policies and processes, working with System members and the Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research in a collaborative manner to address compliance needs.

- Represent the System at national and regional meetings focused on research policy.

- Other duties as assigned.


Education and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree in applicable field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Six years of related experience in research administration, research compliance, or research policy review.

Registration, Certifications, and Licenses:

- Certification within the field of research administration or compliance.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
- Excellent verbal and written communication.

- Strong organizational and analytical skills.

- Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Graduate degree in a science, technology, engineering, or related field.
- Previous governmental relations experience.
- Experience in leadership roles within professional associations focused on research administration or compliance.

Other Requirements:

This is a security-sensitive position and is restricted to U.S. citizens and legal permanent residents only. Only complete applications will be considered for employment at The Texas A&M System Offices. Incomplete job application data could result in your application being rejected without an option to reapply. A cover letter and resume may be required in addition to a completed employment application.

title: Intermediate Transportation Modeller (Strategic Modelling)
location: Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA), ON, ca
description:
We are seeking an a Strategic Transportation Modeller to join our urban transportation team in Canada. In this pivotal role, you will lead the development and implementation of sophisticated transport modeling solutions and strategic planning initiatives that shape the future of urban mobility across the region. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with practical expertise in transportation systems, delivering data-driven insights that inform infrastructure development and policy decisions.

  • Develop, calibrate, and validate advanced transport models using industry-standard software (EMME, VISUM, CUBE, AIMSUN, or similar platforms) to analyze traffic patterns, demand forecasting, and network performance.
  • Utilize and update transport models to assess the impacts of road closures and construction detour plans on the wider transportation systems.
  • Coordinate the modelling work and data exchange between strategic models and micro-level simulation models.
  • Conduct comprehensive transportation studies including transportation master plans, traffic managment plans, traffic impact assessments, corridor studies, active transport plans, parking studies, and feasibility analyses for major infrastructure projects.
  • Analyze complex transportation data sets and synthesize findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Design and execute scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of proposed transport interventions, policy changes, and infrastructure investments.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, urban planners, and government agencies to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
  • Prepare detailed technical reports, presentations, and visualizations that communicate modelling results and planning recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stay current with emerging transport planning methodologies, modeling tools, and best practices in the industry.
  • Mentor junior modellers and planning staff and contribute to the professional development of the team.
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables while maintaining the highest standards of quality and accuracy.
  • Participate in stakeholder engagement sessions and public consultations to gather input and communicate planning initiatives.

Required:

  • University Degree in Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering or relevant field.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in transportation modelling, transportation planning, and / or related traffic engineering and infrastructure planning roles.
  • Advanced proficiency with transport modeling software such as EMME, VISUM, CUBE, AIMSUN, and / or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong expertise in travel demand forecasting, traffic simulation, and network analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with GIS software and spatial data analysis.
  • Excellent project management capabilities with proven ability to deliver complex assignments on schedule.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Solid understanding of transportation planning principles, urban mobility concepts, and transportation policy.

Preferred:

  • Experience working on transportation projects in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA)
  • Experience with construction travel demand management and congestion pricing strategies
  • Familiarity with public transportation planning and integrated mobility solutions
  • Knowledge of sustainable transport initiatives and environmental impact assessment
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages or data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and statistical software (Python, R, SQL, or similar)
  • Professional registration / certification in transportation planning or traffic engineering
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships
  • Background in urban planning or civil engineering complementing transport modeling expertise

title: MSL Cardiology
description:
Job Description Summary

As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you will serve as a trusted scientific partner to leading Cardiology Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals, driving meaningful scientific exchange and advancing evidence-based patient care. In this highly visible field-based role, you will communicate complex clinical and scientific information with accuracy and credibility, helping to deepen understanding of products, therapeutic areas, and emerging data.

You will collaborate closely with healthcare providers to address scientific inquiries, deliver educational insights, and support informed clinical decision-making. Internally, you will work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Commercial, and other teams, providing medical expertise and strategic input across a variety of initiatives.

This role will support the Central territory.

Our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) business is the number one global supplier of contrast media and molecular imaging agents used to enhance medical imaging exams. Used throughout all major disease area diagnostic and treatment pathways, PDx products support three patients every second around the world.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Per the Cardiology Medical engagement plan, interact with KOLs to communicate and advance GE’s Cardiology medical plans and initiatives.

  • Communicate clinical/scientific insights as well as research concepts from KOLs back to medical affairs team members within the organization, for further evaluation. Communication is consistent with bidirectional scientific exchange; encompassing data dissemination and education, as well as the gleaning and capturing of HCP insights.

  • Participate at regional and national cardiology conferences; actively contribute to conference planning, scientific session coverage and development of scientific summary subsequent to conferences.

  • • With oversight from Cardiology Medical Director/ Care Area Lead, provide support to unsolicited investigator sponsored research proposals as well as Company sponsored research.

  • Participate in identification and training of participants in the Company’s speaker’s bureau members, when applicable.

  • Demonstrate full awareness of and compliance with all SOPs and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position. Proactively identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate action as required.

  • Participate in preparation and delivery of training materials to support new and existing medical staff on diagnostic imaging agents used in Cardiology and emerging clinical evidence.

  • Provide medical expertise and support to projects led by US/Canada Medical Affairs and other cross-functional projects, such as advisory boards, educational activities, clinical study support as necessary.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree is (MS, PhD, PharmD, MD)

  • 2+ years Pharmaceutical/Healthcare industry experience (preferably as an MSL with some experience in Cardiology, Radiology, Nuclear Medicine.

  • A proactive leader who translates strategy into timely, impactful outcomes.

  • Experience delivering professional presentations through listed lectures or evidence of teaching

  • Requires ability to travel in excess of 70% (Including some weekends)

  • Required location within territory: (ND,SD,NE,KS,IA,MO,KY,TN) local to major airport.

  • Ideal location: ( Kansas City, Louisville,Nashville)

  • Five or more years’ experience in a medical affairs/MSL role.

  • Nuclear cardiology experience preferred.

  • Location near major metro area with easy airport access.

Job Description

Why work for Texas A&M Engineering?

Engineering has been part of Texas A&M University since its opening in 1876 as the Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas. As the research arm of Engineering, the Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station (TEES) is a state agency within the Texas A&M University System with a mission to improve lives through basic and applied engineering research, workforce development and technology transition. We are deeply committed to recruiting and retaining a talented workforce that embraces our core values of Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Service, by offering competitive salaries, an array of benefits, an extensive support network, and above all, an enriching and highly collaborative working community that is deeply passionate about our vision for higher education, research, and public service.

description:
How would you like to work in a place where your contributions and ideas are valued? A place where you can serve with compassion, pursue excellence and honor every voice? At Wellstar, our mission is simple, yet powerful: to enhance the health and well-being of every person we serve. We are proud to have become a shining example of what's possible when the brightest professionals dedicate themselves to making a difference in the healthcare industry, and in people's lives.

Day (United States of America)

Job Summary:

Functions in a customer service role and responsible for day-to-day operations of the front office area. This includes pre-registration/registration of new patients, scheduling, and general clerical support. Cross trained in all functions and processes of front desk to ensure the smooth operation of the Department. Local travel may be required. This job is typically the first point of contact and must ensure a pleasant compassionate and empathetic experience for patients and visitors. The Patient Representative interviews patients and/or their representatives to obtain complete and accurate demographic, financial and insurance information, required for billing and collecting patient accounts. Conducts intensive screening of all worker's compensation, Medicare, Medicaid and managed care patients for pre-certification requirements and provider service eligibility, prior to registration as applicable. Obtains all necessary customer consents/attestations. Maintains a working knowledge of insurance benefits and coverage verification. Coordinates the collection of estimated patient liabilities, including co-payments when applicable. Responds to customer requests and answers questions regarding various service and account information. Analyzes and rectifies customer concerns using established procedures. Uses computer to access and/or update customer confidential patient records. Must be competent in multiple clerical functions, including: answering multi-line phone system, registering returning and new patients accurately, prepare patient paperwork, verify commercial and government insurances, understand the breakdown of insurance benefits and when authorization may be required per payor requirements, able to review insurance benefits with patient, detail orientated to accurately update and maintain data entry into spreadsheets, maintain inventory of supplies and order when necessary, understand and work in EPIC and OP Rehab EMR System. Reviews and accurately verifies and post payments through EPIC and OP Rehab EMR. Follows WellStar and PAS policy for processing receipts, cash, and end of day closing of cash drawer. Must be able to effectively sort, organize, and maintain various documents to support front office functions and procedures. Refers patients to financial counselor to establish financial arrangements to reduce financial risk for WellStar, helping to ensure that WellStar is reimbursed for its services.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Functions at a professional level during interaction with all customers and co-workers: * Receives requests for appointments from physicians offices and/or employers and makes the necessary pre-admission arrangements, referring to lists of dates allotted for scheduling, and advising physicians office staff and patients of available dates. * Greet all guests with a positive and professional attitude. * Arranges to have patients escorted to procedure areas and/or assigned rooms. * Maintains confidentiality of patient information in accordance with WellStar policy and HIPAA regulations. * Presents a well-groomed and professional image. Must follow WellStar and Outpatient Rehab Dress Code Policy. * Answers incoming phone calls and routes to appropriate parties or addresses issues as directed. * Assists physicians (and their office staff) as well as patients to expedite scheduling, pre-registration, pre-certification and/or prior authorizations. * Maintains courteous and cooperative working relationships with patients/families, co-workers, management, physicians, other professionals, and the general public. Demonstrates the ability to tactfully handle difficult situations. Completes registration process per WellStar policy and regulatory standards. * Interviews each patient or representative in order to obtain complete and accurate demographic. Financial and insurance information, and accurately enters all patient information into the registration system. * Reads physicians orders to determine services requested and to assure order validity. * Obtains new medical record numbers for all new patients. * Obtains all necessary signatures and is knowledgeable regarding any special forms that may be required by patients third party payor. * Documents thorough explanatory notes on patient accounts, concerning any non-routine circumstances clarifying special billing processes. * Re-verifies all information at time of registration process. * Understands and applies WellStar philosophy and objectives and Rehab and PAS policies and procedures, as related to assigned duties. Understands the outpatient registration processes. Works with IT/ EMR on troubleshooting Registration interface errors. * Maintains a working knowledge of the process to verify insurance coverage and benefits. Assist in verifying benefits as needed and all patients end of year. Professional and knowledgeable communication to patient regarding benefits. Completes all revenue collection efforts according to WellStar and PAS policy. * Contacts patients prior to initial visit to discuss co-pay and/or self-pay arrangements. * Collects the co-pay amount at each visit and provides a receipt to the patient. * Balances collection log and receipts at end of each business day. * Explains prompt payment discount policies to self-pay patients. Routes self-pay patients to financial counselor for financial arrangements of self-pay balances, as indicated. * Makes corrections and updates patient account information in computer as necessary. * Documents concise and understandable notes regarding self-pay and co-pay collection activity as indicated. * Timely communicates on all charge addendums. Works efficiently and accurately within designated time frame to ensure a continuity of information and patient flow. * Prepares charts for the clinic in a timely manner. * Consistently demonstrates the ability to organize work, recognize and establish appropriate work priorities, and complete work in a productive manner, without creating backlogs. * Maintains proficiency and accuracy in data entry skills. * Maintains a working knowledge of available information system capabilities and performs all system applications that are required. * Faxes, mails or otherwise provides medical information to referring physicians in a timely manner, as per departmental process. * Accurately provides information to medical record company as requested for review of claims, as per departmental process. * Effectively utilizes and daily maintains all office equipment, phone system and intercom system and PC. * Keeps management (Lead PSR, Clinic Supervisor, Admin) informed of all necessary information; reaches out for assistance as needed. Tracks financial/clinical statistical data as per departmental requirements, and functions in a clerical support role for department. (Typically, this is assigned to only one PSR when there are multiple PSRs in the same department. In that case, this staff members other job responsibilities are reduced to accommodate for these tasks.) * Works EPIC work queues and reports daily per demands. Analytical skills to effectively complete all denials in a timely manner, collaborating with other departments as needed. * Prepares and maintains accurate statistics consisting of visits, new patients, procedures, revenue, patient satisfaction, etc. for the department. * Submits daily, weekly and/or monthly reports of statistical information to administration. * Utilizes Lawson or other method appropriately to maintain departmental ordering/inventory process. * Provides secretarial support to manager and clinical staff in a timely manner, maintaining appropriate confidentiality. * Records and maintains minutes of monthly minutes of monthly departmental meetings. * Maintains educational records for department, including entering educational information into Kronos Timekeeper. * Creates charts, forms, reports and other documents on PC. Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all WellStar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.

    Required Minimum Experience:

    Previous employment record reflects work stability, as indicated by an average work tenure for previous jobs of at least one (1) year. Required and Minimum 2 years of related experience in healthcare work setting, with exposure to front office responsibilities, insurance verification and insurance authorizations Preferred

    Required Minimum Skills:

    Typing and data entry competency; Work with minimal direction after training; Basic computer skills; Insurance terminology and knowledge, pre-certification/authorization process, medical terminology and ICD 10 knowledge preferred; Familiarity with routine office equipment and Microsoft Office. Demonstrated professionalism, effective communication skills and active listening.

6-Month Contract

title: Senior Civil Engineer (Water)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Civil Engineer – Water to join our team in Christchurch! In this opportunity, you’ll lead the design and delivery of 3-waters projects – from master planning through to detailed design and construction – with a focus on pipelines, pump stations and stormwater networks.

This role offers the opportunity to combine technical leadership, project delivery and client engagement while growing your career in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Your day-to-day will see you:

  • Leading detailed design for hydraulics, stormwater runoff, pipeline and pump station to help solve complex challenges across land development, transport and flood management projects/
  • Managing project budget, timelines and resources to deliver quality outcomes for clients.
  • Acting as the key client contact, building strong relationships and proactively seeking business development opportunities with new and existing clients.
  • Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to team development.
  • Championing technical excellence in software such as Civil 3D, 12D, HEC-RAS, TUFLOW, SWMM and GIS tools (QGIS/ArcGIS) to deliver practical, high-quality outcomes.
  • Collaborating across disciplines to align with client goals, regulations and best practice.
  • Staying up to date with industry trends, embracing digital tools to drive efficiency and uncovering new opportunities through your network.

This role is ideal for an engineer with 8+ years’ experience who is passionate about water infrastructure and has achieved (or is working towards) Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status.

  • Tertiary qualifications in Civil, Water, Environmental or Natural Resources Engineering
  • CPEng Status (or working toward)
  • Strong experience in hydraulics, stormwater networks, and pump station/pipeline design.
  • Demonstrated experience in 3 waters projects with a focus on detailed design.
  • Demonstrated project management and delivery capability across all lifecycles, managing budgets, timelines and resource management.
  • Experience with modelling highly desired.
  • Proficiency in Civil 3D, 12D, InfoWorks, HEC-HMS and GIS tools (QGIS/ArcGIS preferred).

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the design and assessment of building mechanical systems. Working within multidisciplinary engineering teams, the role supports projects involving heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), plumbing, and associated building systems across design and operational phases.

This position involves conducting technical analysis, producing engineering documentation, and supporting inspection and condition assessment activities. The role requires coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable Canadian codes and standards while maintaining project scope, schedule, and deliverable quality.

The ideal candidate brings a minimum of seven years of experience in building mechanical systems engineering, with strong exposure to design, assessment, and field investigation across a diverse project portfolio. This includes new construction in healthcare, aviation, commercial and data center sectors, as well as retrofit and upgrade projects in commercial and healthcare facilities. Professional engineering licensure and demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects are essential.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage project scope, schedules, and deliverables to support successful engineering project execution.
  • Perform heating and cooling load calculations and complete HVAC system sizing for ducts, piping, and equipment.
  • Prepare technical documentation including design reports, specifications, and construction drawings mark-ups.
  • Conduct building system inspections and condition assessments for mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Review engineering drawings and specifications for compliance with applicable codes and standards.
  • Develop cost estimates for repair, replacement, and lifecycle maintenance planning.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to support integrated design and project delivery.
  • Participate in client meetings and stakeholder coordination to maintain project alignment.
  • Support field investigations and technical reporting for reserve fund studies and property assessments.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects with varied complexity, ensuring quality control and timely delivery.
  • Post-secondary degree in Mechanical Engineering;
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in building mechanical systems engineering
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems, plumbing systems, fire detection, suppression and safety systems, electrical supply and distribution systems, and lighting systems;
  • Competency with using Autodesk Revit is an asset
  • Familiarity with the Ontario Building Code, the National Fire Code, and the Ontario Electrical Code;
  • Professional designation (P. Eng.)
  • Hands-on practical experience in the testing, repair, and replacement of mechanical equipment is an asset;
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Qualified candidates must be able to clearly and concisely converse with the project team, both internally and externally;
  • Organization skills including maintenance of paper and electronic files;
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite;
  • G class driver’s license and access to own vehicle on a daily basis.
  • Candidates selected for interviews will need to complete a written HVAC/Mechanical engineering knowledge test

title: Wastewater Modeller
description:
Are you ready to be a key member of our Water team, driving growth, innovation and sustainability in the UK Water Sector?

About the Role

The UK water sector is entering a period of unprecedented investment and transformation. As Egis accelerates the growth of its Water Business in the UK, we are building a high-performing multidisciplinary team covering a wide range of services including Flood Risk, Civil Engineering, Nature based Solutions and Hydraulic Modelling; we are going to work for clients both in the regulated and non-regulated sectors including water companies, energy providers, developers and local government among others.

We are looking for a wastewater modeller to help in delivering and developing our services, mainly for water companies, in relation to urban drainage and sewer modelling, supporting clients and informing their asset investment decisions through their optioneering and detail design phases.

This is a rare opportunity to join Egis at a key stage of our UK growth journey, to be part of and help to shape and expand a wastewater modelling capability in the UK, built on Egis’ global infrastructure expertise and long-term commitment to the sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Join our wastewater modelling team bringing your expertise and enthusiasm to help the development of our Infoworks ICM network modelling offer
  • Work with our teams across the UK, Ireland and France to develop and deliver a range of hydraulic modelling services to our clients, promoting best practice and innovation
  • Promote the use of blue and green infrastructure in addition to traditional engineering solutions; champion the use of sustainable drainage systems (SuDS)
  • Provide technical and expert advice to clients, supporting the technical/projects managers in the successful delivery of projects
  • Support business development opportunities, contribution to tenders and proposals
  • Collaborate with wider Egis teams to develop market leading and innovative services to our clients
  • Participate in industry events, seminars and conferences. Showcase Egis technical capability and project experience.

Areas of Past Experience

  • Experience developing, verifying and calibrating Infoworks ICM models for wastewater and urban drainage networks;
  • Hydrological assessment and analysis (e.g. FEH, ReFH)
  • Knowledge of scripting / automation (e.g. Python, Ruby etc) advantageous
  • Experience with other hydraulic modelling packages would be beneficial e.g. Tuflow, Mike, Flood Modeller Pro
  • Experience in flood risk modelling, assessment and mapping would also be beneficial

Key Attributes

  • Hands on, delivery and client focused
  • Energised with a positive and strong work ethic
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to work in multi-disciplinary and remote teams
  • Innovative mindset, always looking to improve, automate, streamline, learn and develop

Qualifications

  • BSc/Eng or MSc/Eng in Civil, Water or Environmental Engineering disciplines
  • Typically 4+ years of experience
  • Obtained or working towards obtaining professional qualification with CIWEM or similar.
  • Demonstrable client, contractor or consultancy experience in UK Water Sector
  • Demonstrable knowledge of regulator (e.g. Environment Agency), modelling requirements and technical standards

Please note that you must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this position.

What’s in It for You?

  • An exciting new growth role in a fast‑organic growing UK business, offering clear and accelerated career progression
  • Top Employers 2025 - Egis recognised across four continents for excellence in HR practices, having been awarded the prestigious Top Employer 2025 certification. Top Employers Institute is the global authority on recognising excellence in people practices.
  • A global leader in green infrastructure - we’re proud to lead the way in sustainable infrastructure, mobility and energy, innovating across the entire value chain and every aspect of the built environment.
  • Highly competitive reward package
  • Hybrid and flexible working
  • 26+ days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Professional development, chartership support & global mobility
  • Supportive, inclusive culture driven by sustainability and long‑term community impact

Ready to Lead?

Join Egis and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of sustainable water infrastructure across the UK.We are committed to our planet

In each project we design, engineer and operate we care deeply about the legacy we’re leaving behind. As part of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to use your skills and expertise to shape a better future for our communities in the UK, and all around the globe.

Our commitment is translated in the work carried out by our Egis Foundation, which funds concrete actions to address the climate crisis and is focused on educational and social initiatives that will help in the responsible and sustainable shift towards a sustainable world.

We are an Equal Opportunities employer and we strive to build a workforce that truly reflects the communities we represent. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. If you decide to apply for an opportunity with us, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

· Receives, inspects, and logs products for accuracy of shipment, temperature, and quality.

· Monitors the point of purchase signs; ensures a variety of recipe cards, product coupons, promotional material, and information on complimentary foods.

· Prepares various deli/bakery items; includes using the appropriate ingredients and proper cooking times for product being made.

· Uses knowledge of scales and weight measures to accurately weigh and label products.

· Participates in pre-inventory preparation; includes back stock and assuring tags match products.

· Sustains a high level of product knowledge and product preparation.

· Other duties as assigned.

· Preferred 1 -2 years grocery retail experience in Food Service department processes and procedures.

· Must have the capacity to take initiative when problems arise.

· Flexibility to adapt in a variety of situations.

title: QA Software Engineer I
description:
For more than 55 years, Family Health Centers of San Diego’s (FHCSD) mission has been to provide caring, affordable, high-quality health care and supportive services to everyone, with a special commitment to uninsured, low-income and medically underserved persons.

FHCSD is one of the top 10 largest federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the country. We operate more than 90 sites across San Diego County, including 29 primary care clinics, 23 behavioral health facilities, 10 physical rehabilitation clinics, nine dental clinics, five vision clinics, four outpatient substance use treatment programs, three mobile medical units, two mobile counseling centers, two urgent care centers, and a pharmacy.

Our staff provides care to over 227,000 patients each year, of whom 91% are low-income and 29% are uninsured. FHCSD provides care to all. Services include, but are not limited to adult care, chronic disease management, pediatrics, comprehensive women’s care including obstetrics, dental, vision, case management, physical rehabilitation, speech therapy for children, vaccinations, infectious diseases, behavioral health, substance use counseling and a host of specialty services including cardiology, podiatry, endocrinology, dermatology, among others. FHCSD also offers supportive services to those who are unsheltered and in need of intensive case management.

The breadth of our clinic locations, services and programs has grown over the last five decades, making us the largest community clinic provider of health care to the uninsured in the county and one of the top 10 largest community clinic organizations in the nation. We are also the largest health care safety-net provider, largest school-based health care provider and the largest mental health provider in the San Diego region.

title: Clinical Practice Liaison – Long Term Care
description:
Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)



About the Role:

The Clinical Practice Liaison (CPL) builds and maintains clinical/scientific relationships with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) and other health care professionals, to communicate and advance Neurocrine’s scientific position in alignment with Medical Affairs strategy. This role supports educational outreach including disease state pathophysiology, diagnosis, and evidence-based treatment options focusing on, but not limited to, Community Mental Health Centers (CMHC), Long Term Care (LTC) and skilled nursing facilities. The territory covers South Carolina, North Carolina, Northern Georgia and a small part of Virginia. It's ideal to live close to a major airport to accommodate the travel schedule.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Develop and maintain strong clinical/scientific integrity with local, regional, and national advanced practice KOLs plus other HCPs as appropriate to facilitate meaningful scientific discussions

  • Identify knowledge gaps across diverse clinical practice settings and provider types to provide appropriate scientific education

  • Effectively educate across a continuum that includes disease state, diagnosis and evidence-based treatment aligned with Medical Affairs' scientific narrative

  • Partner with national and state professional organizations to support education

  • Stay current in latest literature and research within therapeutic area to enable meaningful clinical/scientific interactions

  • Identify and recommend research opportunities and project sites

  • Serve as a scientific resource and trainer for internal Neurocrine teams

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment with initiatives

  • Attend and provide insights from relevant medical congresses

  • Provide feedback on and recommendations for resources to support CPLs in the field (i.e., slides, publications, etc.)

  • Complete required reports and assignments with established deadlines

  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • Master's degree, NP, CNS, PA or equivalent AND 4+ years of similar experience noted above OR

  • PhD, DNP, or PharmD degree AND 2+ years of similar experience noted above

  • Has knowledge of best practices in the functional discipline and familiarity with the broader underlying concepts of related business disciplines

  • Developing reputation inside the company as it relates to area of expertise

  • Ability to work as part of and lead laterally on projects

  • Exhibits leadership skill and ability

  • Excellent computer skills

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking skills

  • Ability to meet multiple deadlines across a variety of projects/programs, with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency

  • Excellent oral, written and presentation skills

  • Therapeutic Area clinical expertise in Psychiatry or Neurology

  • Maintains professional license (ie advanced practice licensure and certification per individual state requirements)

  • Ability to represent NBI in a professional manner at all times

  • Ability to follow fiscal guidelines and adhere to compliance guidelines

#LI-SA1

title: MIM International Site Development Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

This position is part of GE HealthCare's MIM Software business, a leader in vendor-neutral medical imaging software that helps healthcare providers standardize workflows, simplify complex clinical scenarios, and deliver more precise, personalized patient care.
As a Site Development Specialist, you will support the long-term success of our customers after implementation, with a primary focus on customer engagement, software adoption, installed base nurturing, and contract renewals. Job Description

Customer Success & Site Development

Contract Renewals & Installed Base Management

Preferred profile

title: Global Macro Strategy - Citi
description:
Discover your future at Citi
Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

The Global Macro Strategy team in London are looking to hire a senior associate to assist with their research effort. The associate will support senior members of the team by conducting analysis on financial market and economic data to help the team provide robust, thematic trade ideas aimed at the macro hedge fund and real money community. The candidate will also be a part of Citi's monthly asset allocation effort. There will be opportunity to write their own reports as well as assisting the team.


Responsibilities:

  • The Global Macro Strategy team has the responsibility for developing broad macro themes, cross asset class analysis and offers trade ideas aimed at leveraged and macro-oriented investors.
  • Specifically, the team conducts top-down analysis in Rates, FX, Equity, Credit and Commodity markets for DM and EM countries and regions utilizing both linear and non-linear derivatives.
  • The specific responsibilities of this role include: back-testing of trading and investment strategies, construction of macro and leading indicators for financial markets, formulation of macro fair value models, staying up to date and implementing academic insights within global macro space
  • The candidate will have the opportunity to become an integral part of Citi's macro research department. The successful candidate will also work with teams based in NY and Asia, and work with Citi's asset class specialists (rates team, equities team etc).
  • Assist with client inquires and requests (internal and external)


Candidate requirements & qualifications:
  • Experience in top-down macro analysis.
  • Experience working with financial market data is an absolute pre-requisite. Candidate must be able to work independently and understand the nuances of various financial market time series (fixed income vs. equities).
  • Experience with AI and financial data sets is a strong bonus
  • Advanced econometric skillset. Know the appropriate tools and techniques to use for a given type of analysis.
  • Strong programming skills: Python is required for this role
  • Communication skills: Ability to succinctly and clearly articulate complex concepts to a broad audience
  • Attention to detail: Ability to work on a team and to work well under pressure, meeting tight deadlines for a weekly publication schedule.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and proven team player
  • Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within macro research
  • Engage in Citi's broader corporate objectives, such as recruitment and training of junior analysts
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses and regulatory approval.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Candidates applying for this role must be aware that it is a Certified Role, subject to the FCA and PRA Certification Regime.

The Certification Regime is one element of the Individual Accountability Regime which came into effect on 7 March 2016.

Under the Certification Regime, Citi UK regulated entities (Citi entities) must ensure that employees working in certain roles categorised as specified significant harm functions (Certified Roles) are assessed as fit and proper to carry out their role.

Under the guidance provided by the FCA and PRA, firms should have regard to the following when assessing fitness and propriety:

* Honesty, integrity and reputation

* Financial soundness

* Competence and capability

In order to comply with the requirements of the Certification Regime, Citi entities must take reasonable care to ensure that an employee does not perform a Certified Role without first being certified as Fit and Proper. For this reason, you will be assessed for this role against the Fit and Proper requirements, as described above.

This assessment will be carried out through extensive interviews, self-disclosures, permitted criminal record checks, regulated reference checks, credit checks and other background screening checks.

title: CNC-operatörer sökes
description:
Tidamek AB är ett svenskt företag med över 45 års erfarenhet av precisionsbearbetning. Vi specialiserar oss på avancerad maskinbearbetning av gjutjärn, stål och aluminium och levererar innovativa, kostnadseffektiva lösningar till ledande industrikoncerner i Norden. Vi tar oss an komplexa utmaningar och erbjuder skräddarsydda lösningar för branscher som tunga fordon och industriella maskiner. Hos Tidamek kombinerar vi storbolags styrka med småföretagets flexibilitet, alltid med fokus på hög kvalitet och precision.

Som CNC-operatör hos Tidamek blir du en viktig del av vårt produktionsteam, där du bidrar med teknisk noggrannhet och laganda. Du arbetar i en miljö där kvalitet och samarbete är i fokus. Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Sköta och underhålla din CNC-maskin, hålla arbetsplatsen ren och i ordning.
  • Läsa ritningar, utföra mätningar och säkerställa att resultat uppfyller kvalitetskrav.
  • Genomföra verktygsbyten och följa givna instruktioner med precision.
  • Identifiera och agera på avvikelser, både materiella och beteendemässiga, för att säkerställa hög kvalitet.
  • Komma med förbättringsförslag och bidra till genomförandet av dessa.
  • Samarbeta med kollegor för att nå gemensamma produktionsmål – laget framför jaget!

Rollen kräver disciplin, noggrannhet och en genuin vilja att leverera högkvalitativa resultat. Du trivs med repetitiva rutiner och värdesätter en stödjande arbetsmiljö där du kan utvecklas.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är samarbetsvillig, noggrann och engagerad i att leverera kvalitet. Du har följande egenskaper:

  • Kvalitetsfokuserad och disciplinerad: Du lägger stor vikt vid precision och följer rutiner för att säkerställa felfria resultat.
  • Samarbetsorienterad: Du trivs med att arbeta i team, hjälpa kollegor och bidra till gemensamma mål.
  • Analytisk och teknisk: Du är duktig på att läsa ritningar, utföra mätningar och identifiera avvikelser.
  • Engagerad och flitig: Du motiveras av att uppfylla produktionsmål och bidra med förbättringsförslag.
  • Trygg i rutiner: Du trivs i en stabil miljö med tydliga riktlinjer.
  • Du drivs av en professionell arbetsmiljö där du kan bygga långsiktiga relationer och utvecklas genom handledning och utbildning. Erfarenhet av CNC-bearbetning är meriterande, men din inställning och vilja att lära dig är viktigast.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • En stabil och stödjande arbetsmiljö där du kan fokusera på precision och kvalitet.
  • Tydliga rutiner och handledning för att utvecklas som CNC-operatör.
  • Ett engagerat team som värdesätter samarbete och gemensamma mål.
  • Möjlighet att bidra med förbättringsförslag och påverka våra processer.

Är du den vi söker?

Om du är redo att ta dig an en roll där din noggrannhet och laganda gör skillnad, skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team på Tidamek.

title: Level II Technician
description:
Location: Macon,Georgia,United States

Level II Technician

Job Summary

The Level II Technician is a senior technical expert at Spinen, responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and supporting hybrid infrastructure across client environments including core networking, Windows Server services, virtualization, and cloud platforms. This role handles complex incidents and escalations, leads infrastructure projects, migrations, and collaborates with Solution Managers, Customer Success Managers, vendors, and clients to deliver secure, stable, and scalable outcomes.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Implement and support LAN, WAN, wireless, and firewall solutions for SMB client environments (5- 250 users)
  • Own advanced troubleshooting of complex network issues, including routing, switching, firewall rules, VPN connectivity, and performance degradation
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to improve long-term network stability
  • Lead network refresh, migration, and standardization projects
  • Configure and manage firewalls, VPNs (site-to-site and client-based), and secure remote access solutions
  • Support network security best practices
  • Align networking configurations with security and compliance requirements
  • Act as an escalation resource for high-priority incidents and service requests
  • Support 24x7 on-call rotation for managed services clients as a senior escalation resource
  • Coordinate with vendors, ISPs, and carriers to resolve outages and chronic performance issues
  • Collaborate with Pod Leadership on client network strategy and improvement plans
  • Support networking components within Azure, Microsoft 365 environments, etc.
  • Administer and support Windows Server services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy), including user/group lifecycle management and policy troubleshooting
  • Manage hybrid identity components, including Microsoft Entra ID administration and Azure AD Connect configuration, synchronization health, and troubleshooting
  • Support server infrastructure in virtualized environments (VMware/Hyper-V), including VM provisioning, patching coordination, performance troubleshooting, and disaster recovery/backup validation
  • Plan and execute patching and maintenance windows for servers and infrastructure, and manage backup/restore operations including monitoring, verification, and periodic recovery testing
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and configuration standards
  • Provide knowledge transfer and guidance to junior technicians

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex server and network issues in MSP environments
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and service teams

Technical Requirements

  • Advanced knowledge of LAN/WAN design, switching, routing, and wireless networking
  • Hands-on experience with firewalls, routers, switches, and access points
  • Strong experience with VPN technologies (site-to-site, client VPNs)
  • Demonstrated experience with Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet, or comparable enterprise networking platforms
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server (2016, 2019 or newer), including: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy
  • Experience with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V)
  • Experience supporting cloud and hybrid environments (Azure, Microsoft 365)
  • Experience using RMM and monitoring platforms
  • Familiarity with PSA/ticketing systems

Required Experience

  • 3-5 years of progressive experience in network or infrastructure engineering roles
  • Demonstrated experience owning and troubleshooting production client networks
  • Experience leading or contributing to client-facing projects

Preferred Certifications & Experience

  • Cisco CCNA / CCNP (or equivalent)
  • Fortinet NSE, Meraki certifications
  • VMware or Microsoft infrastructure certifications
  • Azure networking experience (AZ-700 or equivalent)
  • Experience working in an MSP environment

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds as needed
  • Ability to travel to client sites for deployments and troubleshooting

Apply to this job
